data.name: Smokewagon Pitmaster: Idle BBQ
data.description_full:
Fire up the smoker and start your roadside BBQ adventure! In Smokewagon Pitmaster: Idle BBQ, you’ll run a cozy barbecue food truck on the highway, starting from a small camp-style stand and growing it into a famous Texas BBQ restaurant.

Use relaxing merge gameplay to research new dishes. Merge ingredients, sauces, tools, and BBQ recipes to unlock brisket, ribs, sausages, grilled chicken, side dishes, drinks, and more. Every new recipe brings more hungry travelers to your food truck.

Upgrade your smoker, kitchen, tables, service area, and campsite facilities. Hire helpers, serve faster, and keep your customers happy. As your restaurant grows, expand your roadside camp with string lights, tents, RVs, wooden tables, and rustic western decorations.

This is a relaxing merge restaurant game that combines American BBQ, road trip vibes, camping life, and food truck management. Perfect for players who enjoy cooking games, merge games, restaurant games, and idle tycoon games.

Start with an old food truck, discover more recipes, upgrade your facilities, serve more guests, and turn your roadside BBQ stand into the most popular barbecue camp on the highway!

data.name: 서울에서 살아남기
data.description_full:
서울에서 살아남기, 당신의 수저는 안녕하십니까?

대한민국 서울, 화려한 마천루 아래 고시원에서 시작하는 당신의 이야기.
가진 것은 오직 몸뚱아리와 '흙수저'뿐이지만, 좌절할 시간은 없습니다.
지금 바로 클릭을 시작하고, 서울의 진정한 주인이 되어보세요!

🎮 게임 특징:

⚡ 압도적인 클릭의 맛 (Clicker/Idle):
간단한 터치로 원화를 채굴하세요! 폐지 줍기부터 코딩 알바, 그리고 대치동 과외까지. 더 높은 가치의 일을 통해 수익을 극대화하세요.

🏠 고시원에서 펜트하우스까지:
서울의 맵을 따라 주거 환경을 업그레이드하세요. 반지하의 습기를 뒤로하고, 한강뷰가 펼쳐지는 초호화 펜트하우스 입성이 당신의 최종 목표입니다.

🥄 5단계 수저 진화 시스템:
흙수저에서 시작해 동수저, 은수저, 금수저를 넘어 전설의 다이아수저까지! 수저가 레벨업될수록 당신의 사회적 위상과 자산 가치가 폭발적으로 상승합니다.

💸 현실 공감 부동산 & 패시브 수익:
잠자는 동안에도 돈이 들어오는 시스템을 구축하세요. 무인 카페 운영부터 강남 빌딩 매입까지, 진정한 건물주의 삶을 체험해 보세요.

🎭 매력적인 캐릭터와 스토리:
고시원 총무, 복덕방 아줌마, 성공을 시기하는 빌런들... 서울 살이의 희로애락이 담긴 흥미진진한 에피소드가 당신을 기다립니다.

🏆 도전과 성취:
다양한 미션을 완료하고 특별한 보상을 획득하세요.

지금 바로 '서울에서 살아남기'를 다운로드하고, 서울의 운명을 바꿔보세요!
당신의 성공 신화는 이미 시작되었습니다.

data.name: ZombieTok: The Last Stream
data.description_full:
Welcome to ZombieTok: The Last Stream!

The Apocalypse is here. Zombies have taken the streets, the Wasteland expands, and dangerous Mutants roam the dark. There are no safe zones and no real audience—because you aren't just watching a Livestream, you are the main Streamer of this doomsday show.

[Apocalyptic Livestream, Survival is Content]
In this Wasteland world, every deployment is a Livestream. The audience wants thrills, the Zombies want you dead, and your job is to lead your squad to complete quests, collect gear, upgrade weapons and armor, and create your own epic moments.

[3D Zombie Wasteland, Immersive RPG Experience]
Explore Zombie-infested cities, abandoned streets, and dangerous outposts. Face ordinary zombies, powerful Mutants, and doomsday bosses. Constantly improve character stats, gear strength, and team CP to tackle higher-difficulty PvE Wasteland stages.

[AFK Rewards & Auto-battle for Easy Growth]
Don't want to grind manually? No problem. The game supports Auto-battle and AFK rewards. Even when offline, you can continue gathering resources to help you level up characters, enhance gear, and boost CP. Go Online to claim your rewards and continue your Survival journey.

[Hunter Progression, Build Your Doomsday Squad]
Train multiple characters, each with unique roles and combat abilities. Build the perfect Survival squad through leveling, gear enhancement, stat boosts, and team composition.

[Build a Zombie Farm & Collect Resources]
Catch a Zombie to work for you! Give them a job and make them work overtime to generate endless AFK income! Upgrade your farm to gather even more resources.

[Doomsday Bounties & Cross-Server PvP]
Cooperate across the server to challenge Zombie bosses, and team up on your Livestream for massive rewards. The Apocalypse isn't a solo show—true elites prove themselves on the PvP leaderboards.

[Guild, Friends & Chat Social Features]
Join a Guild, make friends, and discuss team builds, events, and combat strategies in the global Chat. Participate in events with Guild members, challenge tough enemies, and build your own Survival alliance.

[Branching Storyline, The Truth Behind the Livestream]
A complete storyline with multiple branches and endless plot twists. You'll encounter survivors, enemies, Mutants, and the secrets hidden behind the Livestream. Every choice can change your fate.

Your Livestream has started. The Chat is spamming, the Zombies are closing in, and the Wasteland awaits a new survivor legend.

Enter ZombieTok: The Last Stream now! Start your doomsday Livestream, train your hunter squad, utilize AFK Auto-battle, join a Guild, and survive to the very end in both PvE and PvP battlefields!

data.name: Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
data.description_full:
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng là một trò chơi chiến lược quân sự trực tuyến độc đáo. Trò chơi mới này kết hợp chiến thuật quân sự, lối chơi casual và yếu tố mô phỏng, mang đến trải nghiệm hoàn toàn miễn phí và đầy kịch tính cho người hâm mộ game chiến tranh, RTS (Chiến lược thời gian thực) và chiến đấu quân sự.

Xây dựng Căn cứ
Trải nghiệm tính chân thực của chiến tranh hiện đại bằng cách xây dựng và nâng cấp các công sự quân sự, bao gồm tháp pháo phòng không, kho nhiên liệu và nhà máy thiết giáp. Tạo nên một pháo đài thép bất khả xâm phạm với sự cân bằng hoàn hảo giữa tấn công và phòng thủ. Quản lý chuỗi tài nguyên một cách chiến lược để tối đa hóa năng lực sản xuất chiến tranh, đảm bảo căn cứ của bạn sống sót sau những đợt pháo kích dữ dội trong các trận chiến thời gian thực.

Những Đội quân Huyền thoại
Chiêu mộ các vị tướng Thế chiến II huyền thoại như Eisenhower, Patton, Rommel và Zhukov, mỗi người sở hữu kỹ năng chiến thuật độc đáo và lộ trình nâng cấp cá nhân hóa. Kết hợp nhiều đơn vị quân đội - bộ binh, xe tăng, pháo binh và không quân - để tạo thành đội quân tối thượng có khả năng thống trị chiến trường trong cả chiến dịch PvP và PvE.

Chiến lược Chiến thuật
Một chỉ huy thực thụ giành chiến thắng với tổn thất tối thiểu. Những lựa chọn của bạn - lộ trình tấn công, thứ tự triển khai đơn vị và sử dụng kỹ năng chiến thuật thời gian thực - ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến kết quả trận chiến. Làm chủ chiến lược chiến trường, tham gia chiến đấu RTS căng thẳng và giành hết chiến thắng này đến chiến thắng khác trong cuộc chiến hành động nhịp độ nhanh.

Chiến tranh Liên minh

Khám phá những vùng đất ma thuật kỳ lạ đầy rẫy những quái vật đáng sợ và kẻ thù tàn bạo. Chọn ra những anh hùng yêu thích, kết bằng hữu và tham chiến! Đánh bại mọi kẻ thù và xây dựng một đế chế của riêng bạn!

▶▶ Viễn Chinh Bang Hội ◀◀
Trải nghiệm trận chiến hoành tráng giữa Bang hội và Bang hội, nơi các Bang hội cạnh tranh với nhau mở rộng lãnh thổ. Quân lính sẽ nguyên vẹn trong chiến trường đặc biệt này, cho phép bạn phát huy hết tiềm năng của mình mà không phải lo lắng gì! Đoàn kết Bang hội và lập chiến lược chinh phục chiến trường!

▶ ▶Thu Thập Cổ Vật◀◀
Khám phá Cổ Vật cổ đại trong Sảnh Cổ Vật. Nâng cấp và cường hóa chúng để mở khóa sức mạnh thực sự!

▶ ▶ Xây Dựng Vương Quốc ◀◀
Nâng cấp công trình, tiến hành nghiên cứu, huấn luyện lính, thăng cấp Tướng và lãnh đạo Vương quốc của bạn trở nên thịnh vượng trong trò chơi chiến lược này!

▶ ▶Đội Hình Quân Đội Chiến Lược ◀◀
4 loại lính và 6 đội hình khác nhau để bạn lựa chọn! Lập đội hình, tận dụng hệ thống khắc chế và ghép đội với Tướng phù hợp! Hoàn thiện chiến lược để đánh bại kẻ thù của bạn!

▶ ▶Tướng Lĩnh Hùng Mạnh◀◀
Lập đội 5 Tướng mạnh chiến đấu vượt ải chiến dịch theo phong cách RPG! Dẫn dắt Vương quốc bước lên vinh quang xứng danh đại tướng trận chiến!

▶ ▶Thành Lập Bang Hội ◀◀
Tham gia Bang hội để chiến đấu bên cạnh các đồng minh của bạn! Cùng nhau tham chiến để chinh phục nhiều sự kiện thú vị khác nhau: Đại Hội Bang Phái, Thế Chiến KvK, Trận Chiến Hoàng Gia, Trận Chiến Kỳ Quan, Chiến Đấu Quỷ Hắc Ám, và nhiều hơn thế nữa!

▶ ▶Đụng Độ Trực Tuyến Người Chơi Toàn Cầu ◀◀
Chiến đấu với hàng triệu người chơi từ khắp nơi trên thế giới và đánh bại những kẻ cản đường bạn! Giành lấy ngai vàng và thống trị tất cả trong trò chơi chiến lược tuyệt vời này!

▶ ▶Trận Chiến Sống Động◀◀
Trải nghiệm cảm giác chiến tranh hồi hộp khi quân lính đụng độ trong đồ họa 3D đẹp mắt! Xem Tướng của bạn giải phóng các kỹ năng và khai thác sức mạnh thần bí!

data.name: Block.io
data.description_full:
Block.io is a fast, competitive block-puzzle battler where you drop blocks, clear lines, and go head-to-head against players around the world in real time.

Drag colorful blocks onto the 10x10 grid, complete rows and columns to clear them, and chain combos to charge powerful special abilities. The longer your combo, the harder you hit. Outsmart your rival, send garbage blocks to their board, and be the last one standing.

■ REAL-TIME ONLINE 1v1
Get matched with a real opponent and battle live. Every move counts — clear fast, build combos, and crush your rival before they crush you.

■ MULTIPLE MODES
- Solo: practice and chase high combos at your own pace
- 1v1 Duel: classic head-to-head online battles
- 1v4 Arena: survive against four opponents at once
- 2v2 Team: team up and take down the enemy duo

■ 10 SPECIAL ABILITIES
Charge your abilities with combos and unleash them at the perfect moment — slice rows, freeze your rival, drop bombs, raise shields, send mega garbage, and more. Pick your loadout before each match and build your own strategy.

■ SATISFYING COMBO SYSTEM
Chain clears for explosive combos with juicy effects, screen shakes, and rewarding sounds. From GOOD to FANTASTIC — how high can you go?

■ CLASSIC MODES TOO
Prefer a relaxed session? Jump into the classic Block Puzzle mode or the Falling Blocks mode anytime.

■ EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
Simple drag-and-drop controls anyone can pick up in seconds — but mastering combos, abilities, and timing takes real skill.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Block.io delivers quick, addictive, competitive puzzle action. Climb the ranks, sharpen your strategy, and prove you're the best block puzzler out there.

Download Block.io now and start your first battle
data.description_short: Real-time block puzzle battles. Clear lines, use powers, beat your rivals

data.name: Spark Dream Tiles
data.description_full:
✨ Spark Dream Tiles: Where Every Match Ignites a World of Wonder.​ ✨
What if you could playwith your dreams? Welcome to Spark Dream Tiles, a match-3 adventure where your imagination is the ultimate power. Each magical tile holds a sleeping spark. Your task? Match them wisely to create dazzling chain reactions, illuminating breathtaking dreamscapes and bringing a slumbering world of fantasy to vivid, sparkling life.
Awaken the Magic Within:
• The Spark of Creation:​ Every clever match you make releases bursts of brilliant light and energy. Watch as your moves paint the dream world with color, animation, and life. You’re not just solving puzzles—you’re creating art and magic with every swap.
• A Canvas of Dreams:​ Explore ethereal levels that evolve as you play. From starlit libraries to crystalline forests, each dreamscape is a blank slate waiting for your spark to bring forth its hidden beauty and wondrous secrets.
• Power-Ups Born from Imagination:​ Unleash unique abilities like the Dreamweaver’s Touch​ (cleaves a path), the Starburst Cascade​ (triggers cross-board explosions), and the Lumina Charge​ (super-charges adjacent tiles). Your strategy fuels the spectacle.
• A Journey of Luminescent Discovery:​ Progress by restoring light and wonder to forgotten corners of the dream realm. Collect glowing “Lumen” fragments and unlock new, ever-more fantastical tile sets and dream zones. The sense of discovery is constant and rewarding.
• Serene Yet Electrifying Atmosphere:​ Immerse yourself in an ambient, melodic soundtrack that swells with your successes. The gameplay is a perfect balance of thoughtful, calming strategy and moments of exhilarating, spark-filled triumph.
Spark Dream Tilesis for the dreamer, the creator, and the puzzle-lover who finds joy in makingthings beautiful. It’s a game about potential, transformation, and the simple, profound joy of making light where there was none.
👉 Download now. Ignite your first spark, and watch the dream begin.
data.description_short: Where Every Match Ignites a World of Wonder.​

자소서 작성부터 자격증 취득과 면접까지!
현실과 똑같이 재현한 취업 과정을 스트레스 없이 즐겨보세요.
육성 시뮬레이션 맛집 바삭한소프트가 수험생 키우기에 이어 긴 시간 야심차게 준비했습니다!

📕 내가 선택하는 대로 멀티엔딩 ‘스토리 모드’📘
부모님의 잘못으로 빚 100억이 생겼다?
모두 포기하려던 그때, ‘천하그룹’에 대한 소문을 듣게 되는데..
늘 도와주는 스터디원들과 방해하는 세력 사이에서, 나만의 방식으로 나의 운명을 선택해보세요! 엄청난 이야기가 여러분을 기다리고 있을지도 모릅니다.

🏆 국내 최고 연봉자 타이틀을 향해 ‘취업경쟁 모드’📈
방대한 스토리 대신 그저 모든 기업이 탐내는 인재가 되는 걸 추구하는 이들을 위한 모드!
매일 바뀌는 다양한 뉴스를 살피고, 상황에 따라 나만의 전략으로 최고 연봉을 획득해야 합니다💰
그 누구보다 빠르게, 남들과는 다르게 최고의 기업에 입사해보세요! 🚀

✅ 추가로 자랑하고 싶은 우리 게임의 특징들!
1. 낮은 확률을 뚫고 자격증에 합격했을 때, 너무 기뻐서 소리를 지를 수도 있습니다!!!!!!
2. 취업경쟁모드에서는 각 회사들의 가상 직원들이 남겨놓은 회사 리뷰를 읽는 맛이 쏠쏠합니다.
3. 스토리 모드의 각 단계별로 특이한 게임 시스템들이 하나씩 숨어있습니다. 그래서 질리지가 않아요!
4. 이제 입사 1년차가 넘은 바삭한소프트 스토리 기획자의 폼이 아주 좋습니다.
5. 강이현, 신서아 등 수험생 키우기에도 등장했던 캐릭터들을 중간중간 찾아보는 재미가 있습니다.
6. 300개가 넘는 다양한 회사들의 명함을 수집하고 친구들에게 자랑할 수 있습니다.
7. 지금 이 글을 쓰는 순간에도 개발진이 자정까지 야근을 하고 있습니다🥲 늘 그렇듯 게임에 정성을 담았습니다!
8. 바삭한소프트의 개발자 박현호군의 입대 전 마지막 작품입니다. 이 게임이 출시되고 일주일이 지나면 그는 논산훈련소로 떠납니다.
9. 리뷰를 통해 이 게임의 장점을 알려주신다면 이 뒤에 더 추가하겠습니다!

data.name: Rumble Fumble
data.description_full:
Six teams. One throne.
Yeah… it’s a cute little war. Until it isn’t.

Welcome to Rumble Fumble, a real-time 6-player psychological battle arena where chaos meets strategy — and politics gets personal.

There are no hidden cards.
No endless grinding.
No pay-to-win nonsense.

Just the race you choose, your sense of timing, your strategy —
and your ability to read the room better than everyone else.

Out here?
You vote.
You form alliances.
You break them when it makes sense.

Control the flow of power…
or calmly point at someone else and make them the next target.

Every match is a shifting battlefield of politics and social tension.
The player in the lead? They can fall in seconds.
The underdog? One smart move and suddenly they’re running the show.

Power never stays still.
And trust me — this isn’t about fast fingers.

It’s about sharp decisions.
Cool heads.
And knowing exactly when to smile… and when to strike.

One vote can flip the entire game.
One choice can turn five players against you.
And every single match tells a different story.

Now the real question is—

Are you ready to survive?

## Main Features ##

## Real-Time 6-Player PvP Mayhem
Tons of units clashing at once. It’s messy. It’s chaotic. It’s beautiful.

## Political Rounds That Change Everything
Every round, the battlefield can shift. Vote smart — or regret it later.

## Master Unique Races
Each race has real personality.
Distinct troops, legendary units, and some seriously scary skills.
Pick your favorite — or learn them all and keep everyone guessing.

## Charming, Stylish Skins
Let’s be honest. The game’s more fun when you look good.
Equip a slick skin, show it off in the arena,
and make sure they remember exactly who beat them.
data.description_short: Rumble Fumble: Six-player mayhem in real time.

Chuyển Thể [Phàm Nhân Tu Tiên]
Tái hiện chương Tinh Hải kinh điển, đồng hành cùng Hàn Lập từ phàm nhân lịch kiếp đến phi thăng, đắm mình trong thế giới tu tiên nguyên tác.

Vào Game Nhận Ngay Đồng Hành Mạnh
Phúc lợi nhiệm vụ chính tuyến kết hợp thưởng đăng nhập, giúp tân thủ dễ dàng vượt giai đoạn đầu và tăng trưởng nhanh chóng!

Tự động tu luyện khi tắt màn hình, quét ải chỉ với một chạm. Thời gian rảnh cũng có thể không ngừng nâng cao cảnh giới.

Tự do kết hợp nhiều trường phái: sát thương diện rộng, kịch độc, phản đòn. Đầu tư ít, sát thương cao, vượt ải dễ dàng!

Lập đội vượt phó bản, kết đạo lữ, nuôi dưỡng con cái, hành trình tu tiên không còn đơn độc.

Đưa khả năng xây dựng đội hình lên tầm cao mới với Đấu Trường Chân Lý, trò chơi PvP chiến thuật giao tranh tự động nhiều người chơi từ studio đã tạo ra Liên Minh Huyền Thoại.

Thể hiện những nước đi siêu tính toán của bạn ngay từ lúc vạch chiến lược, bố trí đội hình và tùy cơ ứng biến trong các cuộc giao tranh tự động 8 người chơi ai cũng có thể tự do tham gia. Với hàng trăm cách xây dựng đội hình cùng meta luôn biến động, những chiến thuật táo bạo hoàn toàn có thể mang lại chiến thắng lớn… miễn là đội của bạn sống sót lâu hơn mọi đối thủ.

MỘT THẾ GIỚI MỚI VỚI MỖI BẢN CẬP NHẬT
Đồng Quy Giới ĐTCL là một không gian luôn biến đổi, nơi trí tưởng tượng thành hiện thực. Điều đó có nghĩa rằng mỗi bản cập nhật mới sẽ đi cùng chủ đề và cơ chế mới!
Từ học viện phép thuật, những thành phố bị quái vật khổng lồ tàn phá cho đến các lễ hội âm nhạc sôi động, luôn có một thế giới mới đầy hấp dẫn để bước vào chiến đấu.

ROLL CÙNG SỰ HỖN LOẠN
Xây dựng một đội hình trong mơ cùng với những vị tướng từ một bể tướng chung, nơi những lựa chọn táo bạo, xoay bài giây cuối, và sự tình cờ bất ngờ có thể thay đổi cục diện trận đấu. Chiến đấu qua từng vòng để trở thành Chiến Thuật Gia trụ lại cuối cùng, vận dụng sự sáng tạo và mưu lược để biến những đội hình khó lường và các tình huống thay đổi cục diện thành chiến thuật để chiến thắng.

ĐƯA BẠN BÈ TỚI
Thách đấu bạn bè và đối đầu trên cả PC, Mac, và thiết bị di động. Tham gia hàng chờ cùng nhau và xem chiến lược xuất sắc (hoặc chút may mắn) của ai sẽ giúp họ vươn lên vị trí dẫn đầu.

VƯƠN HẠNG TRÊN ĐẤU TRƯỜNG
Với hệ thống thi đấu cạnh tranh đầy đủ và ghép trận PvP, bạn sẽ luôn có đối thủ xứng tầm để kiểm chứng sức mạnh đội hình của mình. Đưa những chiến thuật xịn sò để leo từ Sắt lên tận Thách Đấu, và nhận những phần thưởng Xếp Hạng độc quyền cuối mỗi mùa giải!

PHONG CÁCH CỦA BẠN
Khoe Linh Thú yêu thích của bạn trên đấu trường, hạ gục kẻ địch một cách đầy ấn tượng với các chưởng lực cùng hiệu ứng kết liễu, và di chuyển thật phong cách giữa các thế giới qua những cổng dịch chuyển. Chơi game để mở khóa những vật phẩm mới từ Vé hoặc Vé+, hoặc mua chúng trong cửa hàng ĐTCL.

data.name: Tiểu Cường 3Q
data.description_full:
Kiếp trước ta chỉ là một con kiến nhỏ bé trong thế giới loài người, vậy mà kiếp này lại chuyển sinh đến thời không Tam Quốc của côn trùng! Tuy đều là sâu bọ, nhưng kiếp này ta nhất định sẽ làm nên chuyện lớn!!!
Ta vẫn còn đang chìm đắm trong giấc mộng đẹp thì ngoài cửa bỗng vang lên tiếng: “Hài nhi Phụng Tiên cầu kiến.” Phụng Tiên? Sao nghe quen vậy… Ta còn có con rồi sao? Khoan đã… sao lại có cảm giác chẳng lành thế này...
Trong thế giới vi mô kỳ diệu này, côn trùng không còn là những sinh vật đơn giản nữa. Chúng xuyên không đến thời Tam Quốc, sở hữu trí tuệ và ngôn ngữ. Châu chấu Lưu Bị thống lĩnh “Thục Hán Châu Chấu”, bọ ngựa Tào Tháo dẫn dắt “Ngụy Bọ Ngựa”, còn bọ cánh cứng Tôn Quyền nắm giữ “Đông Ngô Bọ Cánh Cứng”. Vì hòa bình của Tam Quốc Côn Trùng, các loài sâu bọ tập hợp lại, cùng nhau bước vào hành trình phiêu lưu vừa kỳ thú vừa hài hước!
【Diễn giải vui, cải biên có chọn lọc】
Chúng tôi lấy côn trùng làm chủ thể thể hiện, kết hợp các danh tướng Tam Quốc với nhiều loài côn trùng khác nhau. Trong thiết kế, chúng tôi cố gắng giữ lại đặc trưng nguyên bản của từng loài, đồng thời hòa trộn các yếu tố nổi bật của danh tướng trong các tác phẩm giải trí như: vũ khí, tạo hình, trang phục, chiến tích nổi tiếng hay điển tích để phát triển thành kỹ năng riêng biệt.
【Tạm biệt “cày cuốc - nạp tiền”, nâng cấp nhàn rỗi】
“Chơi nhẹ nhàng” và “giảm áp lực” là mục tiêu thiết kế của trò chơi. Chúng tôi mang đến một hoặc nhiều lối chơi đơn giản nhưng đa dạng trải nghiệm. Người chơi có thể tự do khám phá theo cách mình thích. Game hỗ trợ treo máy, kể cả offline vẫn thu thập tài nguyên liên tục. Từ kỹ năng, tăng sao đến tiến cấp – hệ thống phát triển đa chiều giúp tướng côn trùng của bạn nhanh chóng tăng lực chiến, dễ dàng đánh bại kẻ địch.
【Phó bản đa dạng, vượt ải côn trùng】
Bắt côn trùng, hang động, bờ sông, hốc cây phiêu lưu… đồng thời tái hiện các trận chiến kinh điển thời Tam Quốc, mở ra một thế giới Tam Quốc Côn Trùng hoàn toàn khác biệt.
【Vận may bùng nổ – quay liên tục】
Mỗi lần chiêu mộ, chỉ cần đạt điều kiện là có thể nhận thêm một lượt miễn phí. Tích tiểu thành đại, sở hữu hàng ngàn loài côn trùng – thống nhất thế giới côn trùng không còn là giấc mơ!
【Liên minh hội tụ – tranh tài liên server】
Tạo liên minh, chiêu mộ đồng đội, cùng nhau hợp tác chiến đấu, chia sẻ kinh nghiệm và chiến thuật. So tài với người chơi từ các server khác, tận hưởng trọn vẹn niềm vui giao lưu và sự kịch tính của chiến đấu!

Welcome to Forest Screwpuzzle, a calming and addictive puzzle game that combines color matching with mechanical logic! Set in a peaceful forest workshop, your task is simple yet satisfying: remove colorful screws from wooden planks, match three of the same color, and clear the board piece by piece.

How to Play

The game board features wooden planks held in place by rows of colorful screws.

Your goal is to collect three screws of the same color from the board.

Once you have three matching screws, they disappear, and the wooden plank they were holding is removed.

Keep matching and removing planks until all screws are cleared from the board.

Each level presents a new arrangement – some screws are hidden under planks, others are locked behind tricky patterns.

Plan your moves carefully. The order in which you remove screws matters – if you strip away the wrong planks too early, you might trap other screws and make the puzzle unsolvable.

Game Features

Unique Screw‑Matching Mechanic
Instead of swapping or tapping tiles, you actively select and collect screws by color. This fresh twist on match‑3 feels tactile and rewarding.

Challenging Puzzle Design
Hundreds of levels with increasing complexity. As you progress, planks overlap, screws hide beneath layers, and you'll need sharp observation and smart sequencing to succeed.

Calming Forest Atmosphere
Soothing green tones, gentle woodland sounds, and a cozy workshop setting make every session a stress‑free escape into nature.

Helpful Power‑ups

Magnet – Pulls all screws of a chosen color to the front.

Hint – Highlights the next best move.

Shuffle – Rearranges screws for a fresh perspective.

No Time Pressure
Play at your own pace. There are no timers – just pure, thoughtful puzzle solving.


Why You'll Love It

Easy to learn, but offers plenty of brain‑teasing depth.

Perfect for short breaks or longer relaxing sessions.

Beautiful hand‑drawn visuals and a gentle soundtrack.

A rewarding sense of progress – each cleared plank brings you closer to victory.

Ready to clear the forest, one screw at a time?

Download Forest Screwpuzzle today and discover the joy of methodical matching. Can you solve every puzzle and become the ultimate craftsman?
data.description_short: Forest Screwpuzzle  A Relaxing   Puzzle Game

data.name: ArcPulse
data.description_full:
Feel the rhythm. Hit the pulse.

ArcPulse is a fast-paced rhythm reaction game that challenges your timing, focus, and reflexes. Each round generates a unique sequence of glowing pulse points across the screen. Your goal is simple: tap each pulse in sync with its corresponding tone as it lights up. One mistimed tap and your rhythm is broken.

Key Features

- Dynamic pulse sequences: Every round is different. The game randomly generates 3 to 7 pulse points with varying positions, intervals, and tones, ensuring no two rounds play the same.

- Progressive difficulty: The first few rounds ease you in with fixed intervals and simple patterns. As you advance, the game introduces dual-tone cross patterns, variable timing between 400ms and 900ms, and echo delay effects that test your muscle memory and prediction.

- Audio-visual feedback: Each correct tap produces a satisfying tone and a visual burst of light. Hit with perfect timing and you will hear an ascending tone while the pulse radiates with an intensified glow. Miss a beat and the screen signals your mistake with a clear visual and audio cue.

- Dark neon aesthetic: The interface features a dark background with cyan, pink, and purple neon accents. Glowing pulse points and subtle animated backgrounds create an immersive environment that keeps your focus on the rhythm.

- Personal records: Your longest streak and best flow rating are saved locally on your device. Compete against your own performance and push for higher scores with each session.

- Zero permissions required: ArcPulse does not require internet access, location, camera, microphone, or any sensitive permissions. All game data stays on your device.

How to Play

1. A sequence of pulse points appears on screen.
2. Each pulse lights up one by one with a corresponding tone.
3. Tap each pulse at the right moment to score.
4. Complete the full sequence to pass the round.
5. Two missed taps end the round. Retry and improve your streak.

ArcPulse is designed for quick 15-to-30-second sessions, making it perfect for commutes, breaks, or any moment you want to test your rhythm.
data.description_short: Tap glowing pulses in sync with dynamic tones. A rhythm reaction game.

data.name: FlexVane
data.description_full:
FlexVane is a turn-based strategy board game where you guide wind flow through a grid of directional markers. Place and rotate markers to create a clear path from the entry point to the exit within a limited number of turns.

Features:
- 15 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty, from simple straight paths to complex multi-entry puzzles with obstacles
- Intuitive tap-to-place controls: tap any empty cell and choose a direction for the marker
- Clear visual feedback with color-coded entry, exit, and obstacle cells
- Turn counter tracks your performance on each level
- Best turn records saved locally, encouraging replay to optimize your strategy
- Infinite replayability with each level designed to be solvable in multiple ways
- Calm and focused visual style with a light gray board and subtle blue-green accents
- No timers, no pressure - think through each move at your own pace

As you progress through the levels, new challenges are introduced: multiple wind entries requiring coordinated paths, fixed obstacle cells that force detours, and larger 7x7 boards for more complex puzzles. Each level can be replayed to achieve a better turn count, and the game tracks your best performance for every stage.

FlexVane offers a satisfying blend of spatial reasoning and forward planning in a relaxing board game format. Perfect for short play sessions during a commute or a coffee break.

data.name: アヤカシ代行

現代の東京――混乱と絶望に満ちた事件が次々と発生し、人々の心
には不安が広がっていた……。

そんな中、「∞ch」で広く知られる大手インターネット企業「森羅万象」

だが、その正体は――彼らはすべて、“アヤカシ”である。

都市の秩序を守るため、正体不明の穢（けがれ）を排除するのを使命に、

あなたも「代行者」の一人として迎えられ、
そんなアヤカシたちと共に、どこかあたたかい日々を過ごしていく。

誰かの孤独や、言葉にできなかった想いかもしれない。

これは、
人とアヤカシが紡ぐ、
優しくて少し不思議な物語。

個性豊かなアヤカシたちと怪異事件を解決していく都市非日常カードRPGです！

笑って、悩んで、

個性豊かな仲間たちとの物語を、
ぜひお楽しみください！

⸻

Welcome to Weddings Match3, a charming and addictive tile‑matching game inspired by the popular stacking puzzle style. Your mission is simple: tap three identical wedding‑themed tiles to make them disappear. But be careful – tiles are stacked in layers, and you can only select tiles that are fully uncovered!

How to Play

The game is easy to learn but offers deep strategic fun:

Wedding tiles are piled on top of each other in various rows and columns.

You can only tap a tile that is not covered by any other tile.

Each time you select three matching wedding icons, they are removed from the board.

You have a limited number of slots at the bottom of the screen. When you tap a tile, it moves into one of these slots.

If the slots become full without matching three, the game ends.

Clear all tiles from the board to complete the level and advance to the next romantic challenge.

The more levels you complete, the harder they become – with more tiles, tighter layouts, and increasing strategic demands.

Game Features

Challenging Stacking System
Wedding items hide behind others. Plan your clicking order carefully to uncover the tiles you need. One wrong move could block your progress!

Dozens of Romantic Items
Celebrate love with a wide variety of beautifully designed wedding‑themed icons – each with bright, elegant visuals that capture the magic of a perfect wedding day.

Special Power‑ups & Boosters

Shuffle – Rearranges all remaining tiles on the board.

Undo – Reverts your last move.

Extra Slot – Temporarily increases the bottom storage space.

Relaxing Sound & Visuals
Soft, romantic background music and satisfying pop effects make every match enjoyable. The elegant colour palette – whites, golds, pinks, and soft pastels – creates a stress‑free, dreamy atmosphere.

Hundreds of Levels
With hundreds of uniquely designed levels, the challenge never ends. New levels are added regularly to keep you engaged.

Offline Play
No internet connection needed. Play anytime, anywhere – whether you're planning your own wedding or simply relaxing at home.

Why You'll Love It

Simple to learn, but requires strategic thinking – perfect for casual players and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

No time pressure – play at your own pace and enjoy the romantic theme.

Hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty keep the game fresh and exciting.

Free to play – optional hints and power‑ups available when you need extra help.

Beautiful wedding theme – every tile and animation is designed to make you feel the joy and elegance of a wedding celebration.

Ready for a romantic challenge?

Download Weddings Match3 today and match your way through a world of love and celebration. Can you clear every board and become the ultimate wedding‑matching champion? Whether you're a bride‑to‑be, a wedding planner, or just someone who loves a good puzzle, this game is the perfect way to celebrate love – one match at a time!

data.name: Arototo
data.description_full:
Every arrow is boxed in, pointing straight into another one. Tap one and it only moves if its path to the edge is clear. So this isn't about speed. It's about the order. Find the one sequence that frees every arrow, and the whole jammed grid empties out.

There's always a way out. Your job is to find it.

HOW IT WORKS
• A grid packed with arrows, all blocking each other
• Tap an arrow to send it off the board, if its path is clear
• Blocked? Work out which arrow to move first. Then the next.
• Keep going until every last arrow is gone

No luck. No random boards. Every level has a clean solution, and it's on you to see it. One wrong order and you're stuck, so back up, look again, and find the way through.

WHY IT STICKS
• The quiet click of a jam coming undone
• A few minutes that turn the noise in your head down
• Pure logic, not another mindless tapper
• Easy to pick up, genuinely hard to put down

Made for people who like to think a few moves ahead. The arrows are stuck. You're the one who gets them out.

Find the order. Free every arrow.
data.description_short: Stuck? There's always a way out. Find the order, free every arrow.

- Traffic Escape Challenge: Handle car jam inspired layouts, parking jam pressure, and bus rush moments with careful observation instead of random moves.

気づけば人生、ずっと働いてばかり。
そんな社畜ライフにサヨナラして、今度は「骨」として第二の人生を始めよう。
ここは、働きすぎ禁止のホワイト冥界。
ボーンたちとゆる〜く暮らしながら、気ままに強くなれる異世界ライフが君を待っている。

剣士、魔導士、暗殺者、魔女まで――
クセが強すぎるボーンたちが続々登場！
それぞれ異なるスキルや特性を組み合わせ、最強の冥界チームを作り上げよう。
推しボーンを育てるもよし、効率重視で編成するもよし。

骨だらけの世界で、自分だけの軍団を築け！
放置OK・自動戦闘、ボーンだけに任せろ。
忙しい？寝たい？サボりたい？
問題なし。戦うのはボーンたちの仕事だ。
フルオート戦闘＆放置報酬で、アプリを閉じている間もどんどん成長！
通勤中でも、仕事の休憩中でも、気づけば素材も経験値も山盛り。
頑張りすぎない、それが冥界流。

骨から成り上がれ、冥王へ
ただの雑魚ボーンだった君も、やがて冥界を支配する王へ――。
仲間を集め、領地を広げ、強敵を打ち倒しながら、少しずつ冥界の頂点へ近づいていく。
「骨しかない」状態から始まる、成り上がりストーリーを体験せよ！

頭脳派バトル、王の資質を見せつけろ
勝利を決めるのは、戦闘力だけじゃない。
編成、配置、スキル発動のタイミング――
君の判断ひとつで戦況は大きく変わる。
シンプル操作ながら奥深い戦略性。
ひらめきと采配で、最強の敵を打ち破れ！

data.name: Perfect Half - Slice Puzzle
data.description_full:
You stare at the odd-shaped block on the screen. You narrow your eyes, draw a line right down the middle, and swipe. Bam. A perfect 50/50 split.

That satisfying feeling is exactly what Perfect Half - Slice Puzzle is all about. It is a casual game designed to test your eye for symmetry and see how well you can judge exact sizes.

The goal is straightforward: you need to cut in half whatever appears on your screen. You do not need complicated controls or quick reflexes. Just use your finger to divide shapes and try to get as close to a flawless 50/50 ratio as possible. Sometimes the objects are simple. Other times, they are tricky asymmetrical polygons that will turn this into a real brain teaser.

How to play:
• Look closely at the shape in front of you.
• Swipe across the screen to draw a line and slice shapes.
• Aim to create two perfectly equal parts.
• Hit the target accuracy score to move forward. If it is not quite an even cut, you simply retry the level until you get it right.

What to expect:
• Pure focus: This relaxing game has no timers, allowing you to take your time and plan your move.
• Mind training: Sharpen your spatial awareness in a logic puzzle that gently pushes your brain to think differently.
• Play anywhere: Dive into this casual puzzle during your daily commute or while winding down for the night.

Grab your device, trust your instincts, and see if you have what it takes to make the perfect split.

Sıradan bir lise öğrencisi, bir gün aniden ortaya çıkan "Öte Dünya İstilası" olayının ortasında kalır. Çaresizliğin eşiğindeki bu genç, kendi ruhsal enerjisini kontrol etme yeteneğini uyandırır ve saldırıdan kıl payı kurtulmayı başarır.

Ertesi gün, kendilerine "İttifak" diyen bir örgütün ajanı çıkagelir. Ajanın anlattıklarına göre bu dünya, öte dünyadan gelen "İntikamcı Ruhlar"ın tehdidi altındadır; ruhsal enerji yeteneğine sahip "Özel Güç Kullanıcıları" ise gölgelerin ardında onlara karşı savaşmaktadır.

Ajanın rehberliğinde lise öğrencisi, özel yeteneklileri eğiten "Ruhsal Enerji Akademisi"ne transfer olur. Ancak onu bekleyen şey; her biri kendine has kişiliklere sahip yoldaşlarıyla birlikte yapacağı zorlu antrenmanlar ve insanlığın varoluşunu tehdit eden güçlü ruhsal felaketlere karşı verilecek bir ölüm kalım savaşıdır.

▶ Benzersiz Güçlerini Uyandır, Kendi Kaderini Çiz

Her bir savaşçının kendine özgü yetenek sisteminin kilidini açıp derinlemesine geliştirin. Strateji ve bilgelikle dolu bu karakter geliştirme yolculuğunda, savaşçılarınızın savaş alanında fark yaratmasını sağlayın.

▶ Rüya Takımını Kur, Zafer İçin Savaş

Kendine has özelliklere sahip efsanevi savaşçıları toplayıp akıllıca eşleştirin. En güçlü 3 kişilik savaş kadronuzu kurarak, takım ruhunun savaş alanında ışıldamasına tanıklık edin.

data.name: NovaScribe
data.description_full:
Word Logic Training is a brain-training puzzle game that sharpens your logical reasoning and vocabulary skills through engaging word formation challenges.

**How to Play**
Connect adjacent characters on a 4x4 grid to form valid words within 30 seconds. Use rule cards to add strategic depth - match characters by sound, meaning, tone, or radical structure.

**Features**
- 25 progressive levels with increasing difficulty
- 5 rule card types: Same Sound, Same Meaning, Same Tone, Same Radical, Adjacent Roots
- 30-second timed rounds
- Score-based progression with 80-point pass threshold per level
- Combo system for consecutive valid words
- Word dictionary tracking collected words and characters
- Personal best records for score and combo
- Infinite Practice Mode unlocked after completing all levels

**Game Mechanics**
- Form words by tapping adjacent characters (horizontally or vertically connected)
- Each valid word earns 10 base points plus bonuses for rule card usage
- Use rule cards strategically to constrain word formation and earn bonus points
- Cleared characters are replaced by new ones from above
- Complete levels by reaching the pass threshold score

**Visual Style**
Enjoy a warm, paper notebook aesthetic with soft colors and smooth animations that create a relaxed learning atmosphere.

Perfect for vocabulary building and logical reasoning practice during short breaks or commutes.

- Tap and drag to draw a pipe path between two matching color rings
- Connect all pairs on the board

Good for Your Brain

Each pipe connecting puzzle quietly builds your spatial thinking, logical reasoning, and concentration. It's a light mental workout that doesn't feel like work — the kind of brain training game you'll sneak in during a commute, a lunch break, or right before bed.

If you like connect the dots games, color matching puzzles, or line connect games — this one's for you.

【Easy Progression】
No more grinding forever! Main quests, side quests, and daily missions offer significantly increased experience rewards. Level up with ease, mix and match skills and talents freely—getting stronger has never been this simple.

The world beyond the Portals is dangerous, but you never have to fight alone. The robust co-op dungeon system supports multiplayer battles against massive bosses, requiring strategy and teamwork. Loot is shared, and so are the rewards—both gear and friendship.

【One Billion Diamonds】

data.name: Paddle Catch
data.description_full: Paddle Catch is a calm but careful selection game set against a starry sky. Moons and stars appear together on screen, refreshed in new positions every few seconds. Tap moons to score points and keep the round going. Tap stars by mistake and you lose a life—make three errors and the game is over. Because the layout changes often, you cannot rely on memory; you must scan, decide, and tap with confidence each time. Moons and stars look distinct, yet the pressure builds as you hunt for the right target before the screen resets. Simple one-touch controls make it accessible, while the three-strike rule keeps every choice meaningful. Chase a higher score and see how accurately you can read the night sky.
data.description_short: This is a casual game.

data.name: Lightning Avoid
data.description_full: Lightning Avoid is a minimalist reflex game where color is everything. White pixel dots appear across the screen in growing numbers, and each one you tap correctly adds to your score. Black pixels look similar but mean danger—tap a single black dot and the game ends immediately. There is no second chance and no forgiveness for a careless touch. New dots keep spawning, so the playfield becomes busier and your decisions must stay sharp under pressure. The rules take seconds to learn, yet staying focused as the screen fills up is harder than it looks. Pixel Pick rewards careful observation, quick recognition, and disciplined tapping. Chase your high score, pause anytime, and prove you can tell friend from foe in a split second.
data.description_short: This is a casual game.

data.name: Block Slot
data.description_full: Block Slot is a steady-hand arcade challenge where precision matters more than speed. A block floats and drifts across the screen on its own, while a green safe zone marks the only place you can remain without losing. Drag the block to keep it fully inside that zone as it moves and wanders. Every moment you stay within the boundaries adds to your score, rewarding calm control rather than frantic tapping. Leave the zone even briefly and the run is over. The block resists lazy positioning, so small corrections beat wild swipes. Simple to understand yet surprisingly demanding, Zone Balance tests focus, patience, and fine motor control. Pause when needed, restart quickly, and see how long you can hold your nerve.

data.name: Sort the Cargo
data.description_full:
Game Description
Welcome to Cargo Sort — the ultimate container-sorting puzzle! Every level drops a jumbled mess of goods into a cargo container. Your mission? Tap to move items, match three or more of the same kind, and clear the container before it overflows. With stunning, smooth sliding animations, and satisfying pop effects, every tap feels like organizing a real warehouse. Train your brain, kill boredom, and become the master sorter!
Features
Endless Levels — Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles, from easy to brain-melting hard.
Simple & Addictive — Just tap to move items. One finger, infinite fun.
Visual Satisfaction — Bright graphics, juicy pop animations, and ASMR-level sound effects.
Brain Training — Each level tests your sorting logic, spatial planning, and quick thinking.
Quick Rounds — Perfect for bus rides, coffee breaks, or late-night couch sessions.
For Everyone — Kids love the colors, adults love the strategy. All ages welcome.
How to Play
Items arrive randomly inside the cargo container. Tap an item to pick it up, then tap an empty slot to drop it. When three or more identical items line up, they pop and disappear! Your goal: clear all items from the container. But be careful — the container has limited space. If it fills up before you clear everything, it's game over. Plan ahead, group wisely, and use the temporary storage slots strategically.

Why You’ll Love It
A level can be completed in just a few minutes, perfect for a quick game during your commute, while waiting in line, or before bed. Watching the shelves go from a chaotic mess to empty is incredibly satisfying and addictive. You'll never get tired of it. Combined with crisp sound effects and smooth animations, it offers maximum stress relief. Whether you're a seasoned match-3 player or a casual gamer, you'll find your rhythm here.
Ready to Sort?
A variety of levels, each more challenging than the last. From beginner containers to the full-load puzzles, every level tests both your logic and reflexes. Don't let your goods pile up—download Cargo Sort now and start your warehouse organization journey!
data.description_short: Sort, match & clear the cargo! Tap to organize the container!

Passengers are waiting on a moving conveyor belt. Each one has a color — red, blue, yellow, green. Your job? Tap the bus that matches their color and send it to pick them up. Simple, right? Wait — the buses are parked all over the lot, and every bus has a direction arrow.

📦 Clear Every Bus
Your goal is to drive every bus out of the lot, each one loaded with its matching passenger(s). Just a smooth, collision‑free operation.

Can you untangle the bus jam and get everyone to their ride? Tap, match, and roll out — but don’t let them crash! 🚦🚍🔴🔵🟡🟢

Civilization has fallen, but crazy drivers are still tearing down the broken roads! In ChickenGap Road Z, the familiar traffic challenge transforms into a harsh survival test set in a light post-apocalyptic world. SURVIVAL STRATEGY & RISK

Wasteland Timing: Wait for the perfect gap between speeding post-apocalyptic vehicles. A second of hesitation is all it takes for the wasteland to claim its prize.

Push Your Luck: Bank your progress and supplies or risk it all for an absolute record. One mistake, and you are sent right back to the shelter.

Battle-Ready Hero: Our feathered survivor is fully geared up! He is rocking a cap, carrying a survival backpack, and gripping a trusty baseball bat in his wing.
Fractured Highway: Forget smooth roads. The track is full of massive breaks, gaps, and cracks that your chicken must jump across. Instead of boring manholes, you’ll find small, isolated islands of land.
Damaged Traffic: Rusty, dented, and heavily battered cars smash through the wasteland at insane speeds. Learn to "read" this dangerous, broken flow in real-time.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:
One-Handed Control: Super simple mechanics—leap over deep road gaps and dodge roaring cars completely on the go.

data.name: Minicraft: Craftarena Block 3D
data.description_full:
Minicraft: Block Craft 3D is a professional sandbox adventure game that allows players to explore a vast block-based world filled with creativity, survival challenges, and endless possibilities. It is designed for players who enjoy crafting, building, and discovering new environments.

1. Open World Exploration
The game features a large, procedurally generated open world where every area feels unique. Players can explore forests, mountains, caves, deserts, and oceans, making each journey exciting and unpredictable.

2. Creative Building System
With its flexible block-based building system, players can construct anything they imagine. From simple houses to massive cities and detailed structures, creativity has no limits.

3. Survival Mode Challenges
In Survival mode, players must collect resources, craft tools, and defend themselves against hostile creatures. The day and night cycle increases difficulty, as enemies become more dangerous after sunset.

4. Creative Mode Freedom
Creative mode provides unlimited resources and the ability to fly. This mode is perfect for players who want to focus entirely on building and design without survival restrictions.

5. Mining and Crafting Mechanics
Mining plays a central role in the game. Players gather ores and materials to craft tools, weapons, armor, and other useful items using an easy-to-learn crafting system.

6. Enchanting and Brewing Systems
As players progress, they can unlock enchanting and potion brewing features. These systems enhance tools and equipment with special abilities, improving survival and exploration.

7. Mobs and Creatures
The world is filled with a variety of mobs, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adjust their strategies to survive encounters with different creatures.

8. Biomes and Special Dimensions
Multiple biomes offer diverse landscapes, climates, and resources. Special dimensions introduce rare items, tougher enemies, and exciting new adventures.

9. Redstone Engineering
The redstone system allows players to create automated machines, traps, and mechanisms. From basic switches to advanced circuits, it adds depth and creativity to gameplay.

10. Multiplayer Experience
Multiplayer mode enables players to connect, collaborate, or compete with others. Build together, explore new areas, or engage in PvP battles for a more social gaming experience.

In essence, Minicraft: Block Craft 3D stands out through its perfect balance of creative freedom, open-world exploration, and engaging survival challenges. Supported by an active and growing community, the game continues to evolve with new possibilities. Whether you choose to play alone or team up with friends, the blocky world offers endless opportunities for fun and imagination.

data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

data.name: Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle
data.description_full:
Drop cute fruits, merge matching fruits, and become the Fruit King!

Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle is a fun and easy fruit puzzle game where you drop adorable fruit blocks, merge the same fruits, and create bigger and bigger fruits. If you enjoy fruit games, merge games, drop puzzles, block puzzles, or matching puzzle games, this cute fruit puzzle is made for you.

The rules are simple. Drop a fruit into the box, match it with the same fruit, and watch them merge into a bigger fruit. Keep merging fruits to create larger fruits, aim for the final melon, and challenge your best score. It is easy to start, but the more fruits you drop, the more strategy you need.

Fruit King combines the fun of a fruit merge puzzle, the simple control of a drop puzzle, and the satisfying challenge of a block puzzle. Every fruit drop matters. Where should you place the next fruit? Which fruits should you merge first? How can you keep enough space inside the box? Think carefully, drop smartly, and keep your fruit blocks under control.

Enjoy quick play, relaxing breaks, and high-score challenges anytime, anywhere. Simple one-hand controls make it easy to play, while cute fruits, clean design, and bright colors make every round feel fresh and satisfying.

How to Play

1. Drop fruit blocks into the box.
2. Match the same fruits to merge them.
3. Create bigger and bigger fruits.
4. Keep the fruits from overflowing.
5. Reach the final melon and aim for the highest score.

The more you merge, the bigger your fruits become. Small fruits turn into larger fruits, larger fruits lead to even bigger fruits, and the biggest fruit can give you extra score when matched. Plan your fruit drops, build merge chains, and keep the box open as long as you can.

Why You’ll Love Fruit King

- Simple and addictive fruit puzzle gameplay
- Cute fruits and colorful block puzzle design
- Fun merge puzzle mechanics
- Easy one-hand drop puzzle controls
- Satisfying matching game moments
- High-score challenge with replay value
- Great for fans of fruit games and casual puzzle games
- Relaxing, easy to learn, and fun to master

If you like watermelon-style games, fruit merge games, block puzzle games, or casual matching games, Fruit King is a great choice. Drop fruits, merge fruits, match fruits, and keep building bigger fruits until you reach the final melon.

Every round gives you a new chance to beat your best score. One smart fruit drop can open up space. One perfect merge can create a chain reaction. One careful move can save the whole game. That is what makes this fruit block puzzle simple, exciting, and addictive.

Fruit King is not just about dropping fruits randomly. To get a high score, you need to think ahead. Place small fruits carefully, keep similar fruits close together, and save space for bigger fruits. The better your strategy, the longer you can keep merging fruits.

This cute fruit puzzle game is made for players who enjoy simple rules, satisfying merges, and score-based challenges. Play for a few minutes or keep going for a new record. Fruit King is easy to enjoy in short sessions, but it also gives you plenty of reasons to try again.

Thức tỉnh Ngôn Linh kết hợp hiệu ứng hoành tráng chuẩn nguyên tác, những khung hình bùng nổ như Hắc Nhật nở rộ, Quân Diễm ầm vang, đẩy căng sức nóng nhiệt huyết trong từng trận đấu.

Đội ngũ thiết kế hàng đầu trau chuốt từng tạo hình nhân vật, kho Ngoại Hình thời thượng tự do phối đồ, tùy chỉnh toàn diện tạo hình riêng biệt. Đồ họa thế hệ mới, đặc tả chuyển động mượt mà tinh tế, tái hiện sống động các danh cảnh nguyên tác, mỗi khung hình đều là một bữa tiệc thị giác đã mắt.

[Dàn Lồng Tiếng Đỉnh Cao, Lồng Tiếng Nhật Nguyên Bản]

relevance, the calendar view shows form and status without clutter, and the gallery stays one tap from the main frame.

with live scores, home and away form, and a prediction toggle before kickoff. GALLERY holds player shots, stadium images, and matchday wallpapers sorted by collection with a full-screen viewer and save
option. CHALLENGE puts you in goal or in the spot-kick circle—left, centre, right, power—and tracks your coin balance across rounds so each session has weight. A subscription opens the full gallery and raises
the daily prediction limit, and AppMetrica carries real usage signals so the feed stays relevant to what Ajax fans actually follow. Netherlands Ajax News is that tight loop - one headline, one fixture call,
one penalty - while gallery and challenge run alongside the feed without crowding it.

Later clues might refer back to earlier answers. It’s like solving a mystery where each new hint makes the previous ones even clearer.

📈 More Cells, Deeper Logic
As you level up, the clues get trickier. But the rule stays the same: finish one clue, get the next. There’s no time limit — just pure, satisfying deduction.

🏆 The Thrill of Unfolding
There’s a special feeling when the final clue appears and you place that last answer. All the pieces click together. You didn’t have the full picture at the start — you built it, clue by clue.

Drag to Sort: Drag a bubble and drop it onto another related bubble to group them together.

data.name: Arrow quest:Lucky Reward
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward — a gentle puzzle journey where every arrow has somewhere to go.

On each board, arrows point in different directions. Some look left, some look right, others up or down. Your task is simple but thoughtful: release each arrow the way it faces, and watch it slide off the board. No dragging. No rotating. Just pure, careful decision-making.

But there's a quiet challenge beneath the calm surface. If two arrows cross paths and touch, your run loses one chance. You begin every level with three tries. Let them collide too many times, and you'll need to start over.

This is not a game about speed. It's about seeing the board clearly before making a move. Which arrow should go first? Which one is trapped until another leaves? Step by step, the puzzle unfolds like a gentle riddle.

The visuals are soft and clean. The sounds are light and rewarding. Each solved level brings a small sense of progress — like finishing a page in a favorite book.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Arrow Quest fits quietly into your day. No rush. No timers. Just arrows, logic, and a little bit of luck.

data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса

Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

Soccer Ludo offers three incredibly robust, feature-packed main gameplay pillars:
⚽ 1. Soccer (Tactical Finger Football Action!)
Based on the physics-controlled, tactical gameplay of soccer game, this mode turns the pitch into a sub-billiard style tabletop battlefield. Take turns flicking, aiming, and bouncing your team's bottlecap-style player discs into the football. Use strategy to position your defenders, block your goals, and unleash powerful trick shots to blast the ball into the back of your opponent's net!

Online Mode: Enter the global league! Face off against international players in intense, turn-based soccer PvP match.

Computer Mode: play with your formations, angles, and shooting power against a challenging computer opponent.

Local Mode: Experience immediate, action-packed fun against a friend on the same screen— designed for settling friendly rivalries.

Roll the dice and race your tokens to the center of the board. True to the timeless rules you know and love, our Ludo mode is incredibly versatile, offering an array of sub-modes to fit your schedule:

1v1: Go head-to-head PvP match against a single opponent in a high-stakes tactical showdown. Choose between Quick mode for fast bursts of fun or Classic mode for the authentic experience.

4-Player Mode: Gather a full stadium! Compete against three other players in thrilling Quick or Classic matches.

Vs Computer: No internet? No problem. Test your luck and strategy against our computer mode in both Quick and Classic settings.

Local Play Mode: The ultimate couch multiplayer experience. Pass your phone or tablet around with friends and family locally in Quick or Classic variants.

Play with Friends: Form private rooms, invite your best buddies, and determine who the true Ludo Champion is in a Classic match.

Live Room: Create or join public Classic live rooms to chat with and play with board game enthusiasts worldwide in real-time. Do not forget to send gifts to your favorite players to show your support and love.

🔴 3. Carrom (The Classic Strike and Pocket Game)
Step up to the square board and experience realistic board physics. Aim your striker, slice your shots, and pocket your carrom men before your opponent does. Soccer Ludo offers multiple ways to play Carrom:

Online Mode: Match up against real players from around the globe in real-time, competitive play.

Computer Mode: Sharpen your angles, perfect your trick shots, and practice against various difficulty levels.

Local Mode: Turn a single device into a portable carrom board to play with a friend anytime, anywhere.

🏆 Why Choose Soccer Ludo?
Three Games, One Download: Save storage on your device while unlocking endless hours of entertainment. Seamlessly switch between rolling dice, pocketing carrom coins, and scoring spectacular football goals.

Realistic Physics Engine: Feel the realistic slide of the carrom tokens and the authentic momentum and bounces of the football on the pitch.

Intuitive & Smooth Controls: Simple click-and-drag mechanics for Soccer and Carrom, and effortless taps for rolling dice and moving tokens in Ludo.

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play
Start from the Edges: Focus on aligning arrows to the edges first—they have fewer movement options and are easier to lock onto.
You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages—the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation. Ready to match? Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Slide Arrows Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility! Challenge yourself—how fast can you finish them all?

data.name: Trace The Pair
data.description_full:
The basic gameplay is easy to understand: connect the matching marker pairs on the grid with a continuous path that completely covers each cell. Follow simple path rules, move in straight lines and right angles, and avoid path intersections and other marked obstacles. Each level has a 60 second timer, providing new players with ample time to observe, plan, and complete the layout without feeling discouraged.
Early levels use small grids and simple pairing layouts to help beginners adapt quickly. As your skills improve, the game will unlock larger grids and more complex challenges. With its simple minimalist interface and smooth gameplay, it is the perfect entry-level logic puzzle for every casual player!

data.name: Path Painter
data.description_full:
By playing this professional brain training puzzle game, you can improve your attention, focus on details, and sustained concentration. Each level is a targeted mental exercise that helps you improve your observation skills, quick thinking, and precise layout judgment through immersive puzzle solving games.
To clear each stage, you must accurately connect all matching tag pairs on the grid and create a complete overlay path for each cell. Strictly follow the path regulations: only straight and right angle turns are allowed, and all paths must avoid crossing, overlapping, or passing through other fixed markings. The 60 second time limit cultivates your ability to think efficiently under mild time pressure, avoiding careless and impulsive actions.
As the difficulty increases, larger grids and more paired targets require longer sustained attention and more complex logical reasoning. The game has no fancy effects or distracting elements, creating a purely focused environment. Train your attention and improve your logical thinking in the game!

data.name: Ice Fishing
data.description_full:
Ice Fishing drops you onto a shattering ice shelf with one job: keep moving or fall through. You tap the safe floe you want the fisherman to leap to, and the ground you just left caves in behind you. Hesitate and the ice underfoot splinters into open water ice fishing game.
The threat is never only the cold. Polar bears claim entire floes and open rifts swallow careless steps, so each tap is a snap decision between the lane that looks clear and the lane that buys you time. Silver fish drift across the route as your only reward and your only currency, daring you to gamble a detour while the cracks race to catch up ice fishing casino.
Run "Ice Horror", the core mode, and the shelf gets meaner with every level: the ice integrity meter drains faster, hazards crowd in, and your reaction window shrinks toward nothing. Bank the fish you haul back and spend them in the workshop on two distinct gear lines ice fishing live. Cleated Boots stretch the precious milliseconds before a floe gives way, while the Rescue Radio stocks emergency calls that yank you back from a single fatal plunge per run ice fish.
Every finished run is etched onto the Survivors board under your chosen callsign, ranked by how many steps you outlasted and how many fish you carried out of the storm ice fishing games. Chase a longer line on the board, a deeper level, and a fuller fish bank, one nerve-shredding tap at a time ice season.

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.
data.description_short: Vita Sort: Mahjong tile sort puzzle. Plan, categorize, relax & train brain.

THE GEOMETRIC PUZZLE OF YOUR DREAMS
Cozy Polygon is your personal space for peace and focus. Download it today to begin your calming journey! data.name: Rune Duel: Dark Match 3 RPG

⚔ RUNE DUEL: PUZZLE RPG DARK FANTASY ⚔

Chain elemental runes, forge your hero and slay dark bosses in a dark fantasy match 3 RPG — a single-player puzzle RPG with the depth of a classic RPG.
Play fully offline — no internet required.

═══ GAMEPLAY ═══

Strategic match 3: chain runes of fire, water, lightning, nature, moon and darkness to unleash devastating magic. Chain the biggest combos to deal massive damage.

Real-time simultaneous combat: you and the enemy act at the same time. Every chain you form deals damage. Every second you lose punishes you. Reflexes, board reading and element choice decide the fight.

6 enemy personalities: Aggressive, Defensive, Cursed, Berserker, Healer and Warded. Adapt your build to each combat.

═══ FORGE YOUR HERO ═══

Deep gear system: weapons, armor, helmets, gloves, boots, rings and runes. 5 rarities — from common to MYTHIC.

Equipment sets: combine pieces from the same set to activate 2pc and 4pc bonuses. Phoenix, Vampire, Guardian, Joker, Mage, Berserker — each with its own playstyle.

Collectible pets: they join you in combat with unique abilities. Level them up to power them further.

125 achievements with ranks: from Initiate to Eternal Legend. Each rank unlocks permanent bonuses.

═══ CONTENT ═══

4 dark worlds: The Runic Wilds, The Burning Reaches, The Sunken Tides and The Celestial Void. Each one with its atmosphere, unique enemies and final bosses.

Final Sanctum: 9 final bosses with their own personality and exclusive mechanics.

ETERNAL MODE ∞: face endless challenges. Each level gets harder. How far will you go?

Goblin's Burrow mini-game: a press-your-luck dungeon — descend deeper for richer loot, but cash out before the goblin wakes.

The Bazaar: a rotating store of chests and gear — buy what you need and sell what you don't.

═══ SEASONS & EVENTS ═══

The Wandering Merchant: for a limited time, a traveling merchant appears with exclusive deals and rare stock.

data.name: Gridlock Sudoku
data.description_full:
Are you looking for a puzzle game with clear rules, smooth gameplay, and easy to learn? This number observation puzzle is your perfect choice! The core gameplay couldn't be simpler. With just a gentle tap, you can select any blank grid cell and then choose the corresponding number from the keyboard to fill in the blank space. The game uses a scientific color discrimination system to help beginners quickly distinguish different types of numbers. All preset numbers at fixed levels are displayed in black, cannot be modified, and serve as the standard basis for solving puzzles. Meanwhile, every number you manually add will be displayed in blue.
The humanized error reminder function helps new players grow quickly. Entering an incorrect number will trigger a pale pink cell reminder, allowing you to immediately recognize the error, reconsider your judgment, and correct the mistake. There are no complex challenges, no difficult logical barriers, and no time constraints. You can freely practice your observations and numerical judgments. Start your puzzle journey with ease and enjoy the pure beginner friendly fun of brain games!

data.name: Pigment Pivot
data.description_full:
This soothing colorful bottle classification puzzle game is a perfect casual game to relax and relieve daily stress while passing leisure time! Designed for pure leisure and mental relaxation, it offers gentle and focused gameplay that can calm chaotic thoughts while exercising your brain in the easiest way possible.
Each level has a set of small bottles stacked with randomly mixed colored balls. Your goal is to rearrange these vibrant balls and purify each small bottle into a single uniform color. The game rules are very simple and easy to remember: only the top ball of each small bottle can be moved, and you can only place it on an empty small bottle or above a matching colored ball. There are no complex operations, no sudden difficulties, only stable and orderly sorting pleasure.
The uniqueness of this game lies in its zero luck design - each solvable level depends entirely on your patience and logical judgment, rather than random guessing. You can stop and think at any time, freely adjust the sorting order, and explore the best sorting rhythm. Immerse yourself in neat color classification, repair cluttered stacking combinations, and experience the peaceful and satisfying joy of turning messy small bottles into perfectly unified color series!

全圖鑒收集講究緣分，緣分到來誰也擋不住。抽卡無需繁瑣儀式，不用焚香沐浴、不看時辰風水，指尖輕輕一劃，英靈自動排隊前來歸順。滿倉只是起步，養到會進化才是真正本領！

【變強有捷徑：花式進化，成就骨王】
還在苦研複雜進化路線？我們的養成邏輯簡單直接。輕鬆培養即可快速變強，一路橫掃對手毫無壓力。每隻骷髏都能花式「進化」—— 從灰撲撲小骨頭變成青熒到發光骷髏王，外型與實力雙重飛升，進化之路永無止境～

【陣容有講究：自由搭配，陣陣都強】
他人絞盡腦汁研究陣容，我們的小骷髏只有隨心所欲。戰力擔當、輸出核心、防禦大將隨意組合，流派套路自由切換，無需死抄作業，不被固定玩法束縛。輕鬆搭配即可橫掃戰場，你的戰術你做主，魔界任你馳騁！

【稱王有坦途：從骨到王，輕鬆無壓】
開局只是一隻無人在意的小骷髏，全程佛系養成、花式進化、隨心搭配。輕輕鬆鬆晉升魔界戰神。讓整個魔界都知道 —— 輕鬆是態度，養成才是王道！

You're a first-year at an ancient school of magic. Classes during the day, mischief after dark, and a castle full of things you're not supposed to touch.

A SCHOOL FULL MYSTERIES AND PUZZLES
Wizard World: Harry's Mystery is a magic adventure built as a playground, not a homework list. Wander the corridors. Sneak into rooms you weren't invited to. Cast spells and watch what happens. Try every door – most of them open.

Your spellbook grows as you learn. Combat dragon magic when you need it, mischief when you don't. Lift a classmate off the ground. Set a chandelier swinging. MAGICAL CREATURES IN THE WILD

- Magic adventure set inside a school of magic

WHO IS Wizard World: Harry's Mystery FOR?

Your magic adventure starts now.

Những quy tắc cũ đã bị phá vỡ, cơ hội mới dâng trào như thủy triều. Tại nơi đây, từng khu rừng tĩnh lặng, từng mặt hồ sâu thẳm, mọi Hồn Thú kỳ dị, mọi Võ Hồn huyền bí… Sử Lai Khắc Thất Quái, các Trưởng Lão Võ Hồn Điện đều mang theo câu chuyện của họ chờ bạn khám phá. Gỡ Bỏ Ràng Buộc, Chiến Đấu Không Giới Hạn

Tái hiện trọn vẹn trải nghiệm chiến đấu nguyên tác. Chiến đấu không khóa mục tiêu, né tránh linh hoạt, tung đòn trên không, thi triển Hồn Kỹ mượt mà, chuyển đổi Võ Hồn liền mạch. Kết hợp chiến thuật Hồn Kỹ tùy chỉnh, tận dụng thuộc tính để áp chế kẻ địch. Mỗi trận chiến đều là sân khấu cho kỹ năng và chiến thuật của bạn. Tận hưởng những trận chiến bùng nổ, mãn nhãn, và cảm nhận trọn vẹn sức hút độc đáo trong !
Mở Khóa Săn Hồn - Khai Mở Con Đường Hồn Sư Tối Thượng

Cảnh báo! Hồn Thú xuất hiện phía trước! Tại đây, bạn sẽ bước vào hành trình săn Hồn Thú chân thực, đối đầu với những Hồn Thú hình thái đa dạng, sức mạnh khủng khiếp trong những trận chiến nghẹt thở. Đánh bại Hồn Thú để hấp thụ Hồn Cốt Hồn Hoàn, mở khóa vô vàn năng lực, từng bước đột phá, tiến tới Con Đường Thành Thần!
Chất Lượng Đỉnh Cao - Tái Hiện Chuẩn Hoạt Hình

Được cấp phép bản quyền cả phim hoạt hình và tiểu thuyết nguyên tác, với mô hình nhân vật và diễn biến cốt truyện có độ chính xác cao, trung thành với nguyên tác. Bạn sẽ bước vào Hành Trình Đấu La của riêng mình, trải nghiệm những ký ức trong quá khứ của Đường Tam, Tiểu Vũ và những nhân vật huyền thoại, cùng họ trưởng thành, khám phá những câu chuyện mới trên con đường tu luyện thành Thần!

Your mission is to track wild animals, survive dangerous encounters, and complete action filled shooting missions. Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter delivers realistic gameplay with smooth controls and immersive hunting environments.

Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter includes a variety of famous wild animals often featured in hunting games. Hunt powerful lions, dangerous tigers, fast deer, giant elephants, aggressive rhinos, wolves, bears, crocodiles, zebras, and wild boars across different environments. Every mission in Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter offers unique wildlife movement and challenging hunting situations.

The dinosaur mode in Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter introduces thrilling prehistoric action. Face terrifying dinosaurs including Tyrannosaurus Rex, Velociraptor, Triceratops, Spinosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Ankylosaurus, and flying Pterosaurs. Dinosaur mode in Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter creates intense survival hunting gameplay with giant creatures roaming through volcanic valleys, dense jungles, rocky cliffs, and ancient rivers.

Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter also features exciting gameplay modes including jeep mode and helicopter mode. In jeep mode, players travel across rugged safari terrains while chasing moving targets. The jeep missions in Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter create fast paced action where timing and accuracy are essential. Helicopter mode provides aerial hunting gameplay where players aim from above and track animals and dinosaurs across massive open environments.

Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter offers multiple sniper rifles and modern weapons with upgrade systems for damage, zoom, reload speed, and stability. Unlock new sniper weapons and improve your shooting performance as you progress through Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter. Each weapon in Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter is designed with realistic detail and smooth animations.

The environments in Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter are designed for immersive gameplay and realistic exploration. Explore foggy forests, green jungles, safari grasslands, snowy mountains, river valleys, desert regions, and prehistoric dinosaur worlds. Dynamic weather and lighting effects make Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter visually engaging and exciting.

Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter provides smooth gameplay performance with optimized controls for an enjoyable hunting experience. Whether you are hunting lions in the safari, tracking deer in the forest, or surviving dinosaur attacks in prehistoric mode, Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter delivers action packed gameplay for all hunting game fans.

Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter features realistic sound effects including jungle ambience, animal roars, dinosaur sounds, rifle firing effects, and environmental audio that improve immersion. The combination of realistic visuals and exciting gameplay makes Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter a complete hunting adventure.

If you enjoy sniper shooting games, wildlife hunting games, safari adventure games, dinosaur survival games, jeep shooting missions, and helicopter sniper action, then Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter is the perfect game for you.

Download Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter now and experience realistic animal hunting, dinosaur mode, jeep missions, helicopter sniper gameplay, and thrilling shooting action across multiple environments.

Đây là bất ngờ lớn nhất: Người chơi may mắn có thể đổi nhận hoa thật – và bạn có thể là người tiếp theo! Sự lãng mạn từ game nở rộ ngoài đời thực, đầy đủ sự trang trọng!

data.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
data.description_full:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。
