data.name: Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi
data.description_full:
Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. Bạn nhập vai đạo sĩ bước đi trên lằn ranh âm - dương, họa phù chú, dựng đàn tế, trấn phong những linh hồn cuồng loạn đang thức tỉnh. Từ ánh linh hỏa bốc lên nơi pháp đàn đến khoảnh khắc phong ấn nghẹt thở, mọi trải nghiệm đều phủ màu ma mị và căng thẳng tột độ. Ở đó, bạn nắm giữ quyền năng thao túng âm dương, khắc chế tà lực và xoay chuyển thế trận bằng chính đạo thuật của mình trong một thế giới quỷ thần đầy sống động.

- Húp 2000+ lượt miễn phí - Vẽ bùa mỏi tay, Tướng 6 sao về ngay!
Nhà phát hành dành tặng người chơi hơn 2000 lượt quay tướng hoàn toàn miễn phí như một lời chào sân đầy thành ý. Ngay khi bước vào thế giới tà khí, bạn đã có thể khai đàn, vẽ bùa và triệu hồi liên tục mà không cần đắn đo tài nguyên. Hàng nghìn cơ hội mở phong ấn, săn tìm Tướng 6 sao đang chờ đón, giúp hành trình trấn áp quỷ thần khởi đầu thuận lợi và bùng nổ ngay từ những phút đầu tiên.

- 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. Trong không gian u ám và ma lực bủa vây, chỉ những đạo sĩ am hiểu thiên đạo mới đủ sức bước tiếp qua vô hạn tầng tháp.

- Game "chiều" đạo sĩ nhất: Chơi mỗi ngày - tặng ngay VIP 6
Giữa thế giới tà khí u ám, đạo sĩ không đơn độc trên hành trình trấn ấn quỷ thần. Phúc lợi dày đặc trải dài theo từng cấp độ, đặc biệt tặng miễn phí VIP 6 chỉ cần chăm chỉ đăng nhập mỗi ngày. Không cần hiến tế tài nguyên, không cần đổi chác vận may - càng tu luyện, càng được ưu đãi, để pháp lực thăng hoa và quyền năng ngày một lớn mạnh.

data.name: MergeHex-Color Calm
data.description_full:
Looking for a perfect way to unwind and challenge your brain? Welcome to MergeHex: Color Calm, a soothing yet deeply engaging hex-puzzle game designed to melt your stress away! 🧩✨

In MergeHex: Color Calm, your goal is simple but satisfying: strategic placement and colorful chain reactions. Keep your board clear, immerse yourself in the gentle flow of colors, and master the art of the perfect merge! 🌈🧘

How to Play:
🎨 Place the Hexes: Drag and drop unique hexagonal blocks with different colored segments onto the grid.
🎨 Match and Stack: Position identical colors next to each other. When they touch, the matching colors will automatically stack and merge onto a single tile!
🎨 Clear the Board: Once a tile stacks enough matching colors, it triggers a satisfying burst and clears from the board, freeing up vital space.
🎨 Achieve Victory: Reach the target score or clear enough blocks before the entire grid gets filled up to win the level!

Why You Will Love MergeHex:
🧠 Relaxing Yet Strategic Gameplay: No rushing, no frantic timers. Take your time to plan your moves and enjoy a truly peaceful puzzle experience.
✨ Spectacular Chain Reactions: Watch with pure satisfaction as one smart placement triggers multiple color stacks and clears the entire board in beautiful harmony!
🎵 Soothing Audiovisuals: Immerse yourself in clean, minimalist design, elegant color palettes, and a calming ambient soundtrack.
🏆 Levels to Master: Progress through beautifully designed levels that gently scale in complexity, keeping your mind sharp and entertained.

Discover your inner zen and test your puzzle skills at the same time. Download MergeHex: Color Calm today and start your relaxing color-merging journey! ⬡🎨🕊️

石川界人、伊東健人、小倉唯、鬼頭明里、黒沢ともよ、小林裕介、関根瞳、能登麻美子、広瀬裕也、堀江瞬、前野智昭 他（敬称略）

【黒の龍王】は錬金術と言霊で人間たちを支配し、この世界に君臨した。

これこそが、竜族と人間、そして混血種たちの気の遠くなるほど長い歴史のはじまりだった。
さまざまな思惑が錯綜する世界で、竜の討伐を目的としたカッセル学院を舞台に、新たな運命の輪が廻り始める。

data.name: Mahjong Crush: Tile Match
data.description_full:
Mahjong Crush: Tile Match puts a new spin on the classic: instead of tapping pairs, you slide tiles across the board and match them on collision. It sounds simple — and it is to pick up — but clearing a full board takes real planning.

🀄 Slide to match
Push a tile and watch it glide. When two matching suits meet, they disappear. The satisfying click of a clean collision never gets old.

🧩 Think a few moves ahead
Each slide shifts the whole board. A good move creates a chain; a careless one closes off your options. Levels start approachable and gradually ask more of you — planning a sequence, setting up combos, working around the layout.

🌿 Play at your own pace
No countdown timers. Take your time to read the board, line up the right push, and feel the quiet satisfaction of a well-played level. If you get stuck, hints and shuffle are there when you need them.

✨ Clean visuals, clear tiles
Large, sharp tiles that are easy to read — especially on bigger screens. Smooth animations and subtle feedback on every match, without going overboard.

WHAT YOU DO
Pick jobs from a rotating board where cargo type, payout, distance, and client tier all matter. Hire drivers whose traits change speed, pay, and how carefully they handle freight. Buy vans and semis, tap dispatch, and watch your trucks move across the country. Every clean delivery builds your reputation and your bank balance.

KEY FEATURES
• Fleet garage packed with dozens of real-world inspired trucks
• Driver roster with traits that shift speed, pay, and cargo care
• HQ Network: buy hubs to unlock new states and longer routes
• Company levels, reputation stars, and deep upgrade trees
• Research lab, achievements, and mega contracts from major clients
• World events that boost or disrupt the freight market
• Road incidents that put real decisions in your hands
• Diesel Cans to finish a haul early when you want the payout now

data.name: โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉัน
data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!
กิจกรรมเล่นเกมลุ้นรับดอกไม้จริงเปิดให้ร่วมสนุกได้ตลอด พร้อมจัดส่งตรงถึงบ้านสำหรับผู้เล่นในประเทศไทย!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

Needles streaming in from every angle. Balloons drifting through the air.

Beat your longest survival time. Your best records stay with you.

Every choice carries weight.
Pull out your phone anywhere — at a cafe, on the train, at a campsite, in bed before sleep.

Who's faster. Who's cooler under pressure.

Every choice is in your hands.

It's the trump card that breaks defensive players and flips the match in an instant.

Your shield isn't invincible. Take enough heavy hits and it cracks, then shatters. Block, dodge, or counter — every choice decides the match.

data.name: Merge Parade
data.description_full:
■ Build Your Army on a 5×5 Grid.

Merge Parade is a formation-based auto-battler set on a 5×5 grid. Buy monsters, merge them into stronger evolutions, and arrange them in a winning layout using powerful adjacency passives. Combat plays out automatically — your only job is deciding who stands where. One smart placement can turn the tide.

■ Core Gameplay Loop

- Buy monsters from the shop
- Place them on your 5×5 grid
- Merge neighboring units to evolve them
- Watch the auto-battle play out
- Use the gold you earn to build an even stronger army for the next fight

Battles end fast — about a minute at normal speed, just 20 seconds at top speed. Perfect for a quick session, addictive enough to lose hours in.

■ From a Tiny Slime to a Mighty Dragon

Goblins, slimes, plants, undead, demons, elementals, dragons, constructs, beasts — nine cute monster tribes to recruit and combine. Follow recipes to merge them, and watch small units evolve into towering powerhouses. Chain a few humble slimes all the way up to a colossal dragon lord and feel the army truly grow.

■ Formation Is Everything

Every unit comes with passives that depend on where you place it: "boost the attack of adjacent allies," "shine alone in a corner," "weaken nearby enemies," and many more. Columns also build up stacks of burn, slow, and shield as the fight unfolds. Push a stack high enough and a Surge erupts — a powerful burst that can flip the whole battle.

Stacking strong units isn't enough. Who stands next to whom, and which column they hold, decides the fight.

■ One Run, Fifteen Battles. Try Again, Try Smarter.

A roguelite structure with lives. Beat all 15 battles to clear a run. Lose a fight but keep your lives, and you can retry. Lose your last life, and the run ends.

Even a defeat teaches you something — new unit knowledge, new recipes discovered, new matchups understood. Every run sharpens your strategy for the next. Once you've conquered the basics, take on the tougher difficulty modes waiting for you. If you've got the skill, the challenge is ready.

■ A Small Goblin with Big Dreams

Meet Gobsby — a small-town goblin with grand ambitions. Beside him is Nick, a chatty little mimic-book, narrating his journey. With only a handful of monster friends at his side, Gobsby sets out for the distant Demon Lord's castle.

Recruit allies. Crush rivals. Watch your tiny gang grow into a marching army — a long, eccentric parade across the world. Cute, a little clumsy, but impossible not to root for. Their story is waiting for you to play it.

■ Perfect For Players Who Love

- Auto-battlers and idle-style action
- Puzzle-strategy and tactical placement
- Collecting, merging, and leveling up
- Quick sessions that fit any pocket of time
- Charming monster designs

■ Free to Play

* Optional in-app purchases / Contains ads

Take command. Set your formation. March your army to victory.

data.name: Pixel Stream 3D
data.description_full:
The conveyor belt is spinning, and the turrets are ready.

Tap the conveyor belt to send out your colored turret. It will automatically fire at voxel cubes of the same color — shells rain down, and cubes shatter, break apart, and disappear one by one.

The number above a turret is its remaining ammo. When it runs out, the turret leaves the stage. If there’s ammo left, it slides into the waiting queue, ready for you to call it back when needed.

The conveyor belt has a limited capacity, and the waiting queue holds only 5 slots. Sent a turret in the wrong order? The belt gets jammed? Then you’ll have to watch those cubes pile up helplessly.

With voxel visuals, a rotatable camera, and the satisfying crunch of cube destruction — each level is a 3D painting waiting to be cleared away.

Highlights

One-tap control: Play with one hand, anytime you have a moment to spare.

Color-matching: Turrets only target cubes of the same color — no manual aiming required.

Conveyor belt capacity: Timing and ordering are your strategy.

5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and deploy at the perfect moment.

Voxel shatter: Every hit is crisp and satisfying.

"Just one more round" magic: Short sessions, but hard to put down.

For those who enjoy a bit of strategy without overcomplicating things, who seek relaxation but still want a dash of tactical thinking. The belt is turning, the turrets are waiting, and the cubes... are about to break.

Songs for every taste
We cover a wide range — mainstream pop hits, kpop favorites, EDM bangers, chill classical piano pieces, and even trending tracks from TikTok and YouTube Shorts. New songs drop weekly so it doesn't get stale.

Actually fun game modes
Challenge Mode lets you compete for high scores on specific songs. Endless Mode keeps throwing tiles at you until you slip up. Normal Mode is there for when you just want to relax and tap at your own pace. And Rush Mode? That's for the people who think they're fast.

Play it anywhere
Works offline. No wifi, no data, no problem. We built it so you can play on the subway, on a plane, or just somewhere with bad signal. It's your piano game, play it wherever.

Free. For real.
No paywall to unlock songs. No "watch 10 ads to continue." Just download and start playing. That's it.

All skill levels
Your 8-year-old cousin can enjoy the easy songs. Your friend who plays rhythm games competitively can sweat through expert mode. Multiple difficulty levels mean nobody gets left out.

Smooth performance
We spent a lot of time making sure there's no input lag. When you tap, the tile responds instantly. Tested across a wide range of Android devices — budget phones included.

WHY PEOPLE STICK AROUND

Honestly, it's the "one more song" thing. You finish a track, see the next one in the list, and think "okay just one more." Before you know it, 40 minutes went by. The combination of rhythm, music, and the satisfaction of nailing a perfect run — it just works.

We also update regularly. New songs, seasonal events, and occasional new features. We actually read the reviews and try to build what players ask for.

data.name: Game Is Hard
data.description_full:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels and hard puzzle challenges, creating a unique hard puzzle game experience.

Every puzzle breaks the rules, no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence in a truly engaging hard puzzle game.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable, until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but progress is always earned.

If you've enjoyed titles like brain test games, logic puzzles, IQ tests, moron test or brain teaser games, and if you love dissecting a good tricky quest, this game is for you. It rewards those who think differently, the curious, the clever, the quietly stubborn.

With full support for offline games, you can play wherever and whenever you want, perfect for no wifi games, no internet games, or long travel sessions. Whether you're on airplane mode or deep underground, all puzzles remain playable.

And yes, it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. Each hard level is designed to challenge your thinking in a unique way. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level is full of hidden ideas and clever mechanics waiting to be discovered. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure, even waiting. Solutions are not always obvious. But when you find them, the satisfaction is incredible, making it a memorable hard puzzle game experience.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.
Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe finally succeed.

Features:
• Handcrafted brain puzzle levels with clever, logical solutions
• Challenging hard puzzle mechanics and unique level design
• Hints are available, but never obvious
• Works fully offline, great for no wifi games and free play
• Minimalist, flat design with zero distractions
• Touch, motion, and sound-based mechanics
• Built for players who enjoy hard, clever, and unusual challenges
• No scores or timers, just pure gameplay

A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

Poor little piggy is trapped behind metal plates. Each plate is held in place by two screws. Your mission? Remove every screw and let the pig run free!

🧠 Trickier Every Level
At first, it’s simple — a few plates, clear colors. But as you progress, more colors appear, and the metal plates twist into crazy shapes. Some screws hide behind others. You’ll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to keep the slots from jamming.

⏱️ Race to Save the Pig
No timer, but you can compete with friends — who can rescue the piggy the fastest?

Ready to pull those screws and free the squealing hero? Start matching and save the pig! 🐽🔴🔵🟡🟢💥

data.name: I Am Fish
data.description_full:
I Am Fish is a charming, physics-based adventure starring four intrepid fish friends, forcibly separated from their home in a pet shop fish tank. Over the course of the game you join them as they swim, fly, roll and chomp their way to the open ocean from the far-flung corners of Barnardshire (the smallest county in England) in their bid for freedom and to re-unite once again.

FINTASTIC FRIENDS

Meet our heroes! Goldfish - cheerful, brave, and adventurous, a natural born swimmer! Pufferfish – a little slow but kind-hearted who can also puff up into a ball and roll across land. Piranha - wild, chaotic, loud, unpredictable, and loves to bite - obviously. Flying Fish – a little aloof at times but a real softy at heart, with the ability to glide through the air! These plucky heroes will leave no bowl unturned, putting their heart and shoal into the mission to re-unite!
data.description_short: I Am Fish is a charming, physics-based adventure starring intrepid fish friends

data.name: Word Solitaire Go
data.description_full:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.
data.description_short: Sort words, solve groups, and relax with solitaire-style puzzles.

data.name: Arcane Maze - Defense Puzzle
data.description_full:
Arcane Maze - Defense Puzzle is a calm logic puzzle game with a light strategic defense twist.

Step into a mystical maze filled with magic pieces, hidden paths, and approaching minions. Your goal is simple: study the board, find a clear path, release each magic piece, and turn every smart move into a defensive strike.

This is not a fast-tapping action game. It is a clean, thoughtful puzzle experience where planning matters. Every piece you clear changes the maze, opens new routes, and helps protect your treasure from enemies moving in from the edge of the board.

Solve the Maze. Build Your Defense.

In each level, you need to carefully read the layout and decide the right order to clear the board. Some pieces can move out immediately. Others are blocked and must wait until the path is opened.

Every successful move has a purpose. As you clear the maze, your released magic pieces automatically help defend against waves of minions. The better your sequence, the smoother your defense becomes.

How to Play
- Study the maze grid and look for pieces with a clear exit path.
- Tap to release a piece when its path is open.
- Clear blocking pieces to unlock new routes.
- Plan your sequence to support your defense.
- Protect your treasure and complete the puzzle.

Each level is easy to understand, but solving the board efficiently takes focus, logic, and a good sense of timing.

Why You’ll Enjoy Arcane Maze
A Clean Logic Puzzle Experience
No complicated controls. No unnecessary pressure. Just observe, plan, and clear the maze step by step.

A Fresh Defense Puzzle Twist
Every move contributes to the battle. Your puzzle-solving decisions become part of your defense strategy.

Calm and Strategic Gameplay
There is no need to rush. Take your time, study the enemy path, and choose the smartest clearing order.

Satisfying Board Clearing
Feel the reward of turning a crowded maze into a clean, empty board. Each cleared piece brings you closer to victory.

Simple Visuals, Clear Decisions
The minimalist design keeps your attention on the puzzle, the maze, and the defense choices that matter.

Many Handcrafted Levels
Explore a wide range of maze layouts designed to test spatial thinking, planning, and problem-solving skills.

A Puzzle Game About Order, Timing, and Strategy
The satisfaction comes from seeing the whole board gradually make sense. A blocked path becomes open. A messy maze becomes organized. A risky defense becomes stable because of one smart move.

In Arcane Maze - Defense Puzzle, every level is a small strategic challenge: clear the maze, release the magic pieces, stop the minions, and protect the treasure.

Ready to enter the maze?
Play Arcane Maze - Defense Puzzle and enjoy a thoughtful mix of logic puzzle, maze clearing, and defense strategy.

ASMR Experience: Enjoy soothing nature soundscapes and crisp bird chirps—the perfect way to de-stress after a long day.

data.name: Tank Frontline
data.description_full:
Welcome to Tank Frontline, a fast arcade defense game built around quick movement, automatic fire, and clear survival decisions.

Drag the tank along the bottom of the battlefield to hold your position. Your cannon automatically targets hostile tanks and falling shells, while enemy tanks can fire back at a slower pace. Keep moving, dodge incoming shots, and collect green repair orbs when your armor needs help.

DRAG-BASED TANK CONTROL
Move by dragging directly on the screen.
No left or right buttons are needed, so every dodge and reposition feels immediate.

AUTOMATIC CANNON FIRE
Your tank fires at nearby threats on its own.
Focus on positioning while the cannon tracks enemy tanks and dangerous incoming shells.

ENEMY TANKS AND FALLING SHELLS
Enemy armor rolls down the lane and can fire low-frequency shots.
Falling shells add pressure, forcing you to keep the tank clear of impact zones.

REPAIR ORBS
Green repair orbs restore tank armor when collected.
Player shots ignore repair orbs, so they stay available until the tank reaches them or they leave the field.

TANK ARMOR SURVIVAL
Only direct contact with the player tank causes damage.
Enemies and shells that pass the bottom edge are removed without reducing armor.

ESCALATING WAVES
The battlefield becomes busier as your score rises.
Survive longer, manage space, and push for a stronger high score.

PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO LOVE

Tank arcade games

Drag-to-dodge action

Automatic shooting defense games

Quick survival challenges

Simple controls with rising pressure
data.description_short: Control your tank, fight foes, dodge fire, collect repairs and survive waves.

data.name: Chicken Road
data.description_full:
Enjoy a calm and colorful casual arcade game with bright lanes and fun sorting mechanics. The gameplay is simple and relaxing: different items such as golden eggs, white feathers, shining coins and fiery elements fall down from the top of the screen. Your task is to drag each item to the correct lane where it belongs.
Each lane has its own receiver at the bottom: one for eggs, one for feathers, one for coins and one for fire. When you place an item in the right lane, you earn points. If you send an item to the wrong lane, especially fire to the wrong place, you lose one of your three lives. The game ends when you run out of lives. The visuals are vibrant and pleasant with a rich purple and gold color scheme, sparkling particle effects, and a cheerful cartoon chicken character with sunglasses at the bottom of the screen. Everything moves smoothly with satisfying animations when items land in the correct lanes.Controls are very easy - simply drag the falling items left or right to the proper lane. The game gives you enough time to observe and react, making it suitable for relaxed play. This makes the game perfect for short sessions or when you want to improve your best score after several attempts. Each round ends with a clear summary of your result.
This casual game is ideal for quiet moments when you need light and focused entertainment. The sound effects are soft and satisfying, with gentle placement sounds and calm background music that keeps the mood positive. The overall experience feels approachable and suitable for players of all ages who enjoy simple sorting and matching-style arcade games.
Return to the sorting lanes whenever you want an easy and enjoyable distraction. With its straightforward drag controls, clear item categories, and gentle difficulty, this casual game offers a relaxing way to sort falling items, avoid mistakes, and gradually improve your score. Drag each item thoughtfully to its correct lane, watch the points add up, and enjoy the calm satisfaction of steady gameplay in this pleasant arcade experience.
data.description_short: Enjoy simple sorting in colorful lanes!

お手軽で爽快なマッチ3パズルをクリアして、おばあちゃんの駄菓子屋さんを大きくしよう！
全1000ステージをクリアすると、物語には驚きの結末が…！？

大人気の「昭和駄菓子屋物語」シリーズが、装いも新たにパズルゲームとして登場。
シリーズファンのあなたも、はじめましてのアナタも、ぜひ手にとってお楽しみください。

やめられない止まらない、クセになっちゃうお手軽爽快パズル。
あったあったと膝を打つ、昭和の懐かしコレクション。
そして、たくさんの登場人物達が織りなす、心にしみる物語。

気がつく頃にはきっとあなたは、この世界の虜になっているに違いありません！

【こんな人にオススメ】
・お手軽なパズルゲームが好きな人
・レトロなものが好きな人
・癒しを求めている人
・近頃感動が足りない人
・昭和生まれの人
・無料ゲームが好きな人
・『思い出の食堂物語』シリーズのファン
・ひとりでゆっくり遊ぶのが好きな人


【ストーリー】
遠い遠い夏の日、
すべてが輝いて見えた、少年少女のころ。
宝石箱みたいだった、あのお店の思い出…。

ここは、誰も知らない小さな町。
なつかしい昭和の匂いあふれる三丁目の横丁に、
小さな駄菓子屋さんがひっそりとあります。

おばあちゃんが、ひとりっきりで、ずーっと
切り盛りしている子供たちの楽園です。

ちょっと覗いてみましょうか。
そして、居眠り気味のおばあちゃんの代わりに、
すこしお店の繁盛を手伝ってみましょうか？

さあ、少しフシギな物語のはじまりです…。


【お手軽安心の親切設計】
◆物語の最後まで楽しめる！
全1000ステージをクリアすると物語のフィナーレまで必ず楽しめます。
終わりが決まっているから、安心して計画的にプレイができます。
毎日ちょっとずつ、自分のペースでお楽しみください。
未完のまま『サ終』なんて本作では無縁なのです！

◆パズルとストーリーのシンプル設計
本作には他人と競争するランキングや、期間限定のイベントといった、
いわゆる「ソシャゲ」的な要素はありません。
丁寧にじっくり楽しめる良質なパズルと、その合間に心を潤す、
「心にしみる物語」だけをゆっくりとお楽しみください。

◆ 基本プレイ無料
アプリは無料で物語の最後まで遊べます！
※一部有料アイテムがございます。

【パズルゲーム】
◆レトロでポップなマッチ3パズル
どこかで見たことあるような？
懐かしの駄菓子屋アイテムをモチーフにしたマッチ３パズル。
ピースを動かして揃えるだけ！
簡単なルールでありながら、奥が深く飽きが来ないパズルゲームです。

◆お手軽で爽快！やめられない止まらない！
ピースを揃えた時にできる「バクダン」などの強力なアイテムは爽快感満点。
もどかしかった「あのピース」を吹き飛ばした時の爽快感がたまらない。
さらに、アイテム同士を合成して、もっと強力な「合体アイテム」を発動！
盤面全体を揺るがすその効果に、きっと病みつきになることでしょう。

◆ボリューム満点！　全1000ステージ！　チャレンジモードも！
やりごたえ抜群の全1000ステージ。
ステージを進めるごとに新しい仕掛けが登場し、飽きることがありません。
終わりが見えているからこそ、やる気が出る。
そんなキモチ、わかりますよね？
全ステージクリアしても、クリア済のステージに再チャレンジできる「チャレンジモード」が遊べます！


【懐かしの駄菓子屋さん】
◆懐かしのあの駄菓子屋さん
誰の心の中にもある、あのお店。
おばあちゃんがひとりで切り盛りする、懐かしのお店。
四季折々に表情を変える、懐かしくも美しい風景は、訪れるたびに飽きることがありません。
最初は少し寂しいお店も、ゲームを進めていくうちに、どんどん賑やかになっていくことでしょう。


◆くだらないものを集めよう！　愛しの昭和レトロアイテムたち！
パズルに少し疲れてしまったら、ぜひ息抜きに「ガチャ」をお試しあれ！
めくるめく、チープとレトロの殿堂。
あの安っぽさ、あのいい加減さ、そして、あの愛おしさ。
ストレスと緊張に溢れた現代社会を生き抜くあなたも「自分は、何を悩んでいたんだろう」と我に返ること請け合いです。

Step into the world's most breathtaking wildernesses and become the most elite hunter on Earth. In **Apex Hunter: Animal Shooting**, every hunt is the ultimate test of skill, precision, and will. From the scorching savannas of Africa to the frozen tundra of the Arctic, from the dense forests of North America to the rugged highlands of Asia, the world's most dangerous prey is waiting for you to pull the trigger.

Explore hyper-realistic environments spanning the globe. These aren't just stunning landscapes; they are living arenas where every terrain demands a different strategy. Pull off long-range precision shots across open plains, track prey with patience through dense jungles, and push your accuracy to the limit in the biting cold of the tundra. One shot. One kill. Perfected. Every shot in Apex Hunter pushes your focus and technique to the limit. Enjoy silky-smooth weapon handling and true-to-life precision where distance, wind, and timing make the difference between a shot and a missed opportunity. Precision isn't just a skill; it's the hunter's only language.

data.name: Arrow Rush 3D
data.description_full:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲

data.name: Medal Hunter: Military Game
data.description_full:
Step into the battlefield in Medal Hunter, a fast-paced shooting game experience where precision, timing, and skill determine every victory. In this intense combat shooting world, you operate powerful military weapons positioned across dangerous warzones, tasked with intercepting enemy forces approaching from the air, sea, and land. Every encounter demands focus. Success belongs to players who can track targets, anticipate movement, and fire at exactly the right moment. The intensity of the front lines is brought to life through stylized, attractive visuals and cinematic audio effects that make every explosion and engine roar feel visceral.

Medal Hunter places you behind specialized war shooting weapons designed to stop incoming enemy units before they escape. Fighter planes streak across the sky, naval vessels cut through open water, and armored vehicles advance across the ground in the middle of large-scale battles. Your role is to stay calm under pressure, follow the movement of each target, and release a perfectly timed shot that turns the tide of battle.

For those seeking competition, Medal Hunter brings intense one-on-one PvP battles against players from around the world in competitive shooting encounters. Battles unfold in fast three-round matches where every decision counts. Victory doesn’t depend on luck or random mechanics — it comes down to skillful shooting accuracy, sharp reflexes, and tactical judgment. In these quick competitive duels, the player who tracks targets more precisely and demonstrates superior shooting skills claims the win.

As you progress, you’ll unlock a powerful arsenal of specialized war weapons built for different combat shooting scenarios. Explosive Flak Cannons tear through incoming aircraft with devastating blasts. Advanced naval cannons/guns are designed to intercept naval targets moving across open water. Precision Guns allow you to eliminate ground vehicles and armored units with deadly accuracy. Each weapon can be upgraded to increase its damage, bullet speed, rate of fire, and overall war shooting power. The more you develop your arsenal, the more dominant your battlefield performance becomes.

Your battles will take place across diverse war operations inspired by different theaters of conflict: Warsaw, Gibraltar, Pearl Harbor and more. Each location introduces new challenges and enemy types, from fast fighter jets and massive naval vessels to tanks and armored vehicles. Every battlefield demands a different tactical approach, forcing you to adapt your weapon choices and shooting tactics to survive the chaos of war.

Gain a tactical edge by equipping a Gunner—a consumable specialist that grants powerful, fixed passive stat boosts to your weapons for the duration of any battle.

Players can also join Clubs to fight alongside other sharpshooters and take part in cooperative war missions. Club members work together in special Club Boss battles, where the entire group attempts to defeat a powerful enemy target. Victory depends on the combined performance of the whole club — every accurate shooting strike brings the team closer to destroying the boss and claiming the reward.

Climb the competitive war leagues and prove yourself against players worldwide. With every victory you collect medals, advance through the ranks, and move closer to becoming a true master of precision combat. You can showcase your trophies in Soldier's Haven - your private Trophy Room. Only the most skilled war shooters will earn the title of Medal Hunter.

The journey to the top is paved with constant progression; as you play, you will unlock new exotic locations, earn exclusive rewards, and gather rare collectibles to complete the Haven. Every milestone allows you to get challenging achievements and level up your profile to show the world your veteran status.

Take your position.
Track the target.
Fire the perfect shot.

Download Medal Hunter and enter the ultimate shooting battlefield.

data.name: Meowdoku: Brain Puzzle Games
data.description_full:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.
Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
💡 Simple Rules, Deep Strategy
The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!
✨ Key Features
🐾 Pure & Immersive Experience
- Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
- Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.
📅 Daily Brain Teasers
- Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
- Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards.
❤️ Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone
Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind.
Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines?
Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

data.name: عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق
data.description_full:
[عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق —— الملحمة الخيالية الأكثر واقعية]
"بالحقيقة نطفئ نار العصر، وبالإرادة نعيد تشكيل العالم"
في عصر يسوده الظلام، أنت وحدك من يحمل نصل الحق، لتحطم القيود وتُخلِّد أسطورتك!

انغمس في عالم MMORPG أسطوري. من تخصيص الأبطال المهيبين إلى معارك الحصار الملحمية، "عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق" ليست مجرد لعبة، بل هي رحلة لإعادة صياغة مصيرك في عالم مليء بالعجائب.

—— نظام الفئات المتطور ——
من الظلال إلى السيادة: اختر طريقك من بين فئات قتالية صُممت بدقة فائقة. سواء اخترت مهارات "المغتال" المتخفي أو بأس المحارب الجبار، ستُحس بقوة إرادتك وهي تُحوِّل بطلك من محارب في الظلام إلى أسطورة تقود الميدان وتغير موازين القوى.

—— فخامة التصميم والجماليات الواقعية ——
أناقة الفرسان الأوفياء: ارتدِ دروعاً وأزياءً أسطورية تعكس هيبة أبطال عالمنا وفخامتهم. نحن نؤمن بأن "الحقيقة" تكمن في التفاصيل؛ لذا قمنا بتصميم أجنحة متلألئة وخيول أسطورية بمعايير جمالية عالية، تمنحك مظهراً مهيباً يفرض احترامه في كل ركن من أركان الممالك التسعة.

—— القتال، العتاد والسيطرة ——
أطفئ نيران الحرب بيدك: تحدَّ زعماء العالم في معارك طاحنة لانتزاع أندر الأسلحة والدروع. كل قطعة عتاد تحصل عليها هي خطوة نحو "إعادة تشكيل العالم". سيطر على ساحات PvP وأثبت أن إرادتك هي القوة الأسمى التي لا يمكن قهرها.

—— نمو ذكي وتطور تلقائي ——
حرر يديك واستمتع بالحرية: لأن وقت البطل ثمين، وفرنا لك نظام قتال تلقائي متقدم يتيح لك رفع مستواك وجمع الموارد بمنتهى السلاسة. حتى وأنت بعيد، يظل بطلك ينمو ويقوى، لتكون دائماً مستعداً لإطفاء نيران الأزمات التي تهدد العصر.

—— تحالفات قوية وروابط اجتماعية ——
قوة الجماعة في نصل واحد: أنشئ "عشيرة" قوية وانخرط في حروب حصار ملحمية مع إخوة السلاح. بفضل نظام التواصل الصوتي المتطور والميزات الاجتماعية العميقة، ستجد من يشاركونك الإرادة لتصنعوا معاً مجد المستقبل في هذا العالم الأسطوري.

—— أهم مميزات اللعبة ——
جوهر الأسطورة: "بالحقيقة نطفئ نار العصر" - قصة عميقة مستوحاة من أساطير الفايكنج الخالدة.

data.name: Loop Master: Color Jam Sort
data.description_full:
Loop Master: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

data.name: Yarn it!
data.description_full:
Time to unwind and get cozy with Yarn It!, the most satisfying puzzle adventure where every thread counts. Join a meow-velous squad of yarn balls that live to roll, unravel, and experience the secret magic tucked away beneath layers of colorful knitting. Take aim at the start of each level, sending your crew spinning onto a masterfully stitched image. As they roll and untangle, these playful wool balls clear the path, turning a simple puzzle into an epic, high-energy streak.
Yarn It! adds a tactile, crafty twist packed with ASMR pleasure and loads of cat-tastic fun. With every tap, you dive into bundles of soft wool, undoing stitches to clear the board. The sound and feel are tuned for maximum chill; stitches pop delightfully with soft clicks and yarn balls bounce with a gentle thud. It’s the perfect combination: an image unraveler that’s as soothing as it is intense, where watching your yarn-kittens pounce on the final stitches is always a total win.
But look out, the sewing board has a mind of its own! This isn't just a lazy tap-fest on the couch—it’s a high-speed brain teaser that keeps you on your paws. As you play, the patterns get wilder, with sneaky blockers and tricky tangles that require a master plan to unknot. You’ll need to outsmart complex stitches to keep your unraveling streak up. Every level adds a fresh, zany twist, turning this cozy craft into a fast-paced feline showdown!
To keep things interesting, you’ll unlock powerful level boosters that turn tight spots into epic comebacks. As you progress, you’ll win purr-emium treats and prizes, giving your pawed pals more ways to dominate the board. Compete with players from around the world, pushing your skills to the limit as you advance in leaderboards and become the ultimate stitch-buster. Remember, when the going gets tough, it’s meow or never!
Yarn It! is your new go-to for relaxing ASMR puzzle action: a fun, exciting, and deeply satisfying adventure filled with wooly wonders, mischievous kittens, soft colors, and endless chances to win rewards. data.name: Arrow Line：Flow Escape ASMR
data.description_full:
🎯 Game Introduction
*Arrow Line: Flow Escape ASMR* is more than just a maze puzzle game; it is an immersive sensory meditation designed for both your mind and your ears. Here, logic meets art, and focus coexists with relaxation. You will step into a minimalist world composed of arrows, lines, and mysterious patterns, where every tap serves as a crucial step toward the exit. This isn't merely about finding a way out; it’s about navigating a chaotic forest of lines to identify the single pattern that stands out—the "odd one out"—to cut through the fog and guide the flow in the right direction. Once everything falls into place, soothing, ASMR-like sound effects will play a tranquil symphony of victory just for you.

🎮 Gameplay Overview
Each level presents a complex maze interwoven with arrows, geometric lines, and hidden patterns. Your objective isn't to move a character, but to use observation and deduction to tap the correct sequence of lines.
Think slowly and analyze precisely; the mazes are static yet intricate, putting your powers of observation and spatial reasoning to the test.
Levels range from simple grids of straight-line arrows to complex circular vortices and fractal tree-like structures.
Play anytime, anywhere—no Wi-Fi required!

---
✨ Game Features
🎨 Minimalist Aesthetics, Visually Soothing
- Pure Visual Style: Featuring soft neon hues, a dark background, and glowing lines, the design ensures a comfortable visual experience that prevents eye strain even during extended play sessions.
🧠 Innovative "Odd-One-Out" Training
- This is more than just puzzle-solving; it is a form of cognitive training. The game features scientifically designed "distractor" patterns that effectively hone your attention span, pattern recognition skills, and ability to filter out distractions.
🚇 Vast Levels & Daily Challenges
- Includes thousands of meticulously crafted levels—each a clever puzzle designed to provide a comprehensive workout for your brain.
- Daily "Anomaly Mazes": A unique maze generated every day, based on real-world traffic data or complex mathematical patterns. ---
✅ Key Highlights
“Find order amidst chaotic lines; escape the maze through the notes of ASMR.”
*Arrow Line: Flow Escape ASMR* masterfully blends the observational challenge of “spotting the difference” with the logical puzzle-solving of “building a path.” Wrapped in exquisite ASMR sound design, it creates an unprecedented experience of focused relaxation. Rather than offering an escape *from* reality, it provides a tranquil, logic-driven micro-universe that you can step into whenever you wish.
Whether you are a puzzle game enthusiast or simply seeking a mobile game to calm your mind and exercise your brain, you will find your own unique “flow moment” right here.
Download it now, put on your headphones, tap the first line, and let your thoughts—guided by the arrows—flow toward the exit. 🎧✨


Finally, we hope you enjoy the game! If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

data.name: DesiLudo
data.description_full:
The rules are very simple, anyone can start and quickly become a master.

At the start of the game, each player begins with four pieces on their starting square. During the game, players take turns rolling the dice. A 6 is rolled, and that player's piece is placed on their starting square. The main objective is to remove all four pieces from your side of the board before any of your opponents.

- A piece can only move when a 6 is rolled.
- Players take turns rolling the dice. If a player rolls a 6, they get another chance to roll.
- All pieces must reach the center of the board to win the game.
- Pieces move clockwise based on the number rolled on the dice.
- Knocking down an opponent's piece grants an extra chance to roll the dice.

Spending happy times together, constantly improving your chess skills, showcasing your personal talents, and becoming a master player!

data.name: Celestia: Immortal path
data.description_full:

Друзья и магия ведут сквозь миры.
Тактика битв решает судьбы,

Демон-бог Сюаньюань выступил против Се Ту. Потерпев поражение, Се Ту бежал, но Янь Мо, движимый жаждой мести, принял облик Тайхао и устроил засаду. Сюаньюань был тяжело ранен, и лишь крошечный осколок его души уцелел, затерявшись в хаосе.

data.name: Fieryy Fruits
data.description_full:
Fieryy Fruits is an easy and exciting puzzle game 🍓 that is nice to enter “for a moment”… and get stuck in for a long time ⏳

Everything is simple and clear from the first seconds: find the same fruits 🍎🍊🍇 and remove them from the field. Touch the tile - it will light up ✨, choose the same one - and the pair will disappear 💥 Easy? Not really 🤔

The trick of the game is that you can only choose free tiles 🔓 And only the one on which there is nothing and which has at least one side open is considered free. Therefore, you will have to think a little before making a move 🧠

With each level, the field becomes more difficult, and victory becomes more pleasant 🏆 This is the same type of game where you constantly tell yourself “one more level - and that's it” 😄

Fieryy Fruits is an ideal option to relax 🌿, clear your head a little and at the same time train your attentiveness 👀

【Соберите офицеров и завоюйте королевство】
Legacy of Nibiru — это увлекательная стратегическая военная игра, объединяющая новые механики и тактику ведения войны. Игра рассказывает историю группы героев и союзников с различным прошлым, которые противостоят захватчикам. Вы выступаете в роли независимого военного командира, ведущего свой народ против злобных орд Теленомуса. После того как командир случайно получает загадочный механизм из древней шумерской эпохи, он направляет свои силы на исследование руин, чтобы интегрировать передовые технологии в мехи. Однако Теленомус продолжает нападать на базу. Командиру предстоит активно развивать свои силы и усиливать боевую мощь, чтобы противостоять вызовам и установить систему прочного мира в этом бурном мире.

Еженедельно предоставляются возможности захватить древние чудеса, а после победы над их охранниками вы сможете получить ценные награды!

The fun of traditional jigsaw puzzles is often slowed down by endless searching and repeated trial and error.

New clues appear as you reveal.
The picture advances as you match.
Easy to start.
Smooth to play.
Hard to stop.

- Move cards to adjust the board and reposition pieces
- Flip face-down cards to reveal hidden images and useful clues
- Match the correct pieces to build the right connections
- Connect image sections to restore the full picture
- Plan your moves carefully to complete each puzzle more efficiently
Key Features
- Beautiful HD puzzle pictures with strong visual appeal
- Card-based jigsaw gameplay with more flexibility and variety
- Hidden-card reveals that add clues, surprise, and memory challenge
- Clear, satisfying feedback when the right pieces connect
- No timers, no pressure — play at your own pace
- From casual levels to more advanced challenges
- New images and scenes to unlock as you progress
Perfect For
- Players who enjoy jigsaw puzzle games
- Fans of sliding puzzle mechanics
- Players who like card matching and reveal-based gameplay
- Anyone looking for a fresh alternative to traditional jigsaw puzzles
- Anyone who enjoys beautiful visuals and a stronger sense of progress
More Than a Puzzle — A New Way to Restore the Picture
Jigcard Explorer Solitaire Pic does more than turn puzzles into cards.
It transforms the process of restoring an image.
Instead of relying only on slow, static trial and error, the game keeps changing through movement, reveals, matching, and connection.
You do not have to wait until the very end to feel rewarded — the picture becomes clearer with every step, and the enjoyment begins long before the puzzle is complete.
Download Jigcard Explorer Solitaire Pic now and discover a fresh new take on card-based jigsaw puzzle fun.

ภายในเกมมีการจัดวางองค์ประกอบของหน้าจอและเมนูต่าง ๆ อย่างเป็นระเบียบ ช่วยให้ผู้ใช้งานสามารถเข้าใจรูปแบบการทำงานของระบบได้ง่าย การควบคุมถูกออกแบบให้ตรงไปตรงมา ลดความยุ่งยากในการใช้งาน และช่วยให้ผู้เล่นสามารถโต้ตอบกับเกมได้อย่างสะดวก

ตัวเกมรองรับผู้ใช้งานหลากหลายรูปแบบ ไม่ว่าจะใช้งานเพียงระยะเวลาสั้นหรือเปิดเล่นต่อเนื่องก็สามารถเข้าถึงฟังก์ชันต่าง ๆ ได้อย่างง่ายดาย แนวคิดหลักของเกมคือการมอบประสบการณ์ที่สบายและเหมาะสำหรับการผ่อนคลายในชีวิตประจำวัน

แอปพลิเคชันนี้จัดทำขึ้นเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ด้านความบันเทิงเท่านั้น เหมาะสำหรับผู้ใช้งานที่มีอายุ 18+ ปีขึ้นไป ภายในแอปไม่มีการใช้เงินจริง ไม่มีธุรกรรมทางการเงิน และไม่มีระบบแลกเปลี่ยนสิ่งใดภายในเกมเป็นมูลค่าในโลกความเป็นจริง

data.name: Duckdoku: Sudoku Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
🦆 Duckdoku — A Brain-Teasing Puzzle with a Twist! 🦆

Think you know Sudoku? Try this adorable and clever challenge! Instead of numbers, you're hunting for hidden ducks. Instead of plain grids, you get colorful blocks. And every move matters.

🎮 How to Play

Tap once to mark a safe spot (no duck there).

Double-tap to flip a tile and reveal a duck — but be careful, because rules are strict!

🧩 The Rules
Every row and every column must contain exactly one duck.
Each color zone (a group of same-colored tiles) must also contain exactly one duck.
And here’s the kicker — ducks cannot be next to each other!

🌈 Colorful & Tricky
As you level up, the board gets bigger, the color zones get more complex, and the puzzles become seriously mind-bending. You’ll need logic, patience, and sharp observation to find the perfect spot for every duck.

🧠 Train Your Brain
This isn’t just a matching game — it’s a pure logic puzzle that makes you think step by step. One wrong tap, and you might trap yourself with no place left for a duck.

Can you find all the hidden ducks without breaking the rules?
Jump in and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test! 🦆🔴🔵🟡🟢
data.description_short: Analyze Sudoku gameplay and find the hidden duck.

data.name: Idle Flight Manager
data.description_full:
One small airplane. One route. $120,000 in the bank... That's how every aviation empire starts.

Idle Flight Manager is a live-world airline management game where you draw routes on a real map, buy real aircraft, and watch your fleet grow from a single regional prop plane into a global operation of Boeing 747s and Airbus A380s. Earn revenue around the clock, even while you're offline.

What you do:
Tap airports to design multi-stop routes. Assign a plane and it begins flying the circuit immediately: carrying passengers, landing, turning around, and flying again. The map fills with glowing route lines as your airline expands. Revenue ticks up with every completed leg.

Key features:
📍 Live world map: real-time plane icons move along your routes on a global map that grows as you unlock regions.
✈️ 50+ real aircraft across 10 tiers. From ATR turboprops and Embraer regional jets to Boeing 777s, Airbus A380s, and exotic premium aircrafts.
🌍 9 unlockable world regions. Expand from US domestic routes to international routes: Canada, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania.
💰 Make money while you sleep: flights complete and income accumulates offline; return to a fully loaded airline fleet!
🎯 Random events: crew strikes, tourism booms, fuel price drops, and government subsidies keep operations unpredictable
🚁 Reward drones: spot drone icons flying across the map and tap to collect bonus cash or miles!
🤖 Auto Flight Manager: assigns planes, creates routes, and re-optimizes your entire network automatically.
🛒 Daily used-plane market, 8 rotating listings at steep discounts or spot-buy a rival's plane directly off the live map.

Progression and Fleet Management:
- Level up by completing route circuits and unlock the next tier of aircraft. Manage plane condition carefully. Let it fall below 50% and revenue drops noticeably. Let it fall below 30% and costs stack heavily.
- Set pricing per route to match your strategy. Economy fills every seat at lower fares. Luxury charges almost double per passenger but risks flying half-empty.
- Build hub airports where multiple routes converge to earn a network revenue bonus. Take bank loans to fund bold expansion. Spend miles to unlock countries, each opening new airports and longer, more profitable routes.

The aircraft catalog:
- Start with regional turboprops on short domestic hops. Work through narrow-bodies like the Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A320neo. Progress into wide-bodies such as the Boeing 787 Dreamliner and Airbus A330neo.
- Finally unlock the legendary flagships: the 747-8, the A380plus, and rare premium aircraft for the most ambitious operators. Collect exclusive variants like the Stealth 787, the Golden A380, the Concorde Neo, and the Zero-G Orbiter.

Your airline, always working: Over 150 NPC airlines populate the skies with ambient traffic. Speed boosts let you accelerate to 2x or 10x speed. Every 7 in-game days, a weekly report delivers claimable cash, miles, and route credits. Your fleet never stops, with or without you.

Start your first flight. The world map is waiting.

An open-source plan is in place for this application. You can check the progress of the open-source initiative via the link: https://aenu.cc/ax360e/

This is the free, ad-supported version of aX360e. You can purchase the ad-free version to support the ongoing development of the emulator.

**Important Notice**: This installation package does not contain any game resources. Please export content from your physical Xbox 360 game discs, convert them to **GOD/ISO format files** for use, or directly load files in the supported formats.

---

Key Features
- Supports GOD/ISO game formats (more formats will be added in future updates)
- Vulkan graphics acceleration support
- Talkback accessibility feature compatibility
- Customizable virtual button layout

data.name: Color Block Blast - Win Cash
data.description_full:
Tired of the same old stacking-and-waiting game play? 💴
Color Block Blast brings you a brand-new tower defense twist on match-3! This isn't just another matching game—it's a strategic battle that puts your tactical skills to the test. 💴

🎯 Core Game play
💴 Colorful blocks marked with numbers sit at the bottom of your screen. They're not just decoration—they are your ammo system!
🎁 Your mission: Use these bottom blocks as turrets, firing upward to precisely hit target blocks of the same color.
⚠️ Key Limitation: Each shot can only eliminate the lowest row aligned directly above its bottom block column.

🧠 Strategy Determines Success
You can't just shoot freely. The numbers on the bottom blocks represent their ammo count or remaining uses—once depleted, that color's ammo disappears forever.

Think like a battlefield commander:

⚡ Precision Budgeting: How do you break through complex stacked layers above with limited bottom ammo?

🗂️ Dynamic Deployment: New blocks fall every time you clear a row. You must constantly adjust the order and position of your bottom blocks to handle ever-changing situations.

💥 Chain Reaction Mechanic: When supporting blocks are eliminated, suspended blocks will collapse and trigger extra clears—bringing unexpected combo advantages!

🎁 Game Features
🎨 Neon Visuals, Satisfying Feedback: High-saturation colors paired with smooth explosion effects make every clear feel as exciting as firing a shot.

🧠 Easy to Learn, Deep Challenge: Tap and shoot—simple rules, but later levels will truly test your advanced planning skills.

🌍 Global Levels, Progressive Difficulty: Hundreds of carefully designed levels, from relaxing casual play to highly challenging stages, suitable for all types of players.

🎵 Rhythm-Driven Immersion: Dynamic electronic music and precise haptic feedback fully immerse you in a world where rhythm and strategy collide.

You're not just a shooter—you're a tactician.
Download Color Block Blast now and experience the thrill of every shot that counts! 🔥📲

data.name: Conquian: Classic Card Game
data.description_full:
Conquian is a card game played with a 40-card deck, where the goal is to form melds (sets or runs) of cards. Its name derives from the Spanish phrase "con quién," meaning "with whom," reflecting its interactive and competitive nature. Over the centuries, Conquian has evolved into various forms, including the popular Rummy games we know today.

Step into the world of Conquian, the legendary ancestor of modern Rummy games! Originating in 17th-century Mexico, this traditional card game combines strategic depth with simple rules, making it a timeless favorite across generations.

Key Features:
🌟 Historical Roots: As the precursor to Rummy, Conquian preserves the essence of classic card gameplay while offering a unique cultural experience rooted in Mexican heritage.
🎓 Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: New players can grasp the basics in minutes with our intuitive tutorial. Perfect for quick matches or extended sessions!
🎨 Elegant Visual Design: Enjoy a clean, minimalist interface with vibrant card illustrations and smooth animations, ensuring a visually pleasing and distraction-free experience.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 All-Ages Fun: Whether you’re a seasoned card enthusiast or a casual player, Conquian’s balanced mechanics appeal to men, women, and children alike. Gather the family for a round of strategic fun!
🌍 Global Popularity: From its origins in Mexico to its spread across Latin America and beyond, Conquian has captivated players worldwide. Known as Cooncan in the Southern United States and Coon Can in other regions, this game has adapted to local cultures while retaining its core charm.

📲 Download now and rediscover the charm of a game that has stood the test of time!

data.name: Get Color Pack: Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
🧪 Get Color Pack: Sort Puzzle - A Fresh Take on Color Sorting Puzzles! 🧪
Dive into a deeply soothing and incredibly satisfying puzzle game where logic meets fluid mechanics. Your objective is crystal clear:
meticulously separate vibrant, mixed liquids so that each beautiful glass bottle contains only one unified color. With every single level you
conquer, the challenge deepens - and so does the immense satisfaction of getting that final pour just right. If you love brain teasers, color
matching, and relaxing offline games, you have found your next puzzle addiction!
💧 Simple Concept, Smart Challenges
You’re presented with an array of beautifully crafted bottles filled with chaotic, layered colors. To solve this mesmerizing water sort puzzle,
you must carefully pour liquid between the bottles, adhering to strict color-matching rules:
• Pour liquid only onto the exact same color, or into a completely empty bottle.
• Stack identical colors together until the tube is full.
• Use your available empty space strategically to maneuver trapped liquids.
• Complete the level by achieving perfectly sorted, single-color bottles.
As you progress, new layers, hidden colors, and tighter layouts appear, meaning every single decision counts.

🧠 Strategy Over Speed
Forget stressful countdowns! There’s absolutely no timer in this game - just you, your mind, and the puzzle. Take a deep breath and think
carefully before each pour. Because you are given a limited number of empty bottles, you cannot simply move colors around endlessly. To
become a master sorter, you’ll need to:
• Anticipate your future moves and visualize the flow of the puzzle.
• Uncover and free trapped colors at the bottom of the tubes.
• Prevent frustrating dead ends by planning your bottle usage.
• Reorganize efficiently with minimal space to keep your board clean.
It’s a magnificent game of foresight, clever rearranging, and cognitive training that will keep your brain sharp.
🎧 Designed to Unwind (ASMR Experience)
Step into a world of ultimate relaxation. Enjoy stunning, fluid animations and beautifully rendered, vibrant colors that make every successful
pour feel incredibly satisfying. The clean user interface, gentle pace, and soothing aesthetic create a highly relaxing environment designed
to melt your stress away. Hidden colors and surprise mechanics add moments of discovery, making this the perfect ASMR-inspired digital
retreat after a long day.
🛠 Tools When You Need Them
We want you to feel challenged, not frustrated! If you ever hit a tough spot or make a mistake, our helpful in-game features are there to
save the day:
• Undo recent moves: Made a wrong pour? Simply rewind and try a different strategy.
• Add an extra bottle: Stuck with no empty space? Drop in a brand new, empty tube for ultimate flexibility.
• Reveal hidden layers: Peek at what's underneath to properly plan your next combination.
• Seamless progression: Continue advancing through thousands of levels without ever feeling hopelessly stuck.
🌟 Why You Will Love Get Color Pack:
• 1000+ uniquely designed levels with steadily increasing difficulty.
• Stunning, vibrant graphics and satisfying liquid pouring effects.
• No internet connection required - enjoy this relaxing offline game anywhere, anytime!
• Easy to learn with one-finger controls, but hard to master.
• Perfect for all ages, from kids learning colors to adults seeking a daily mental workout.
Whether you’re sharpening your logic skills, training your brain, or simply looking for a peaceful, stress-relieving way to pass the time during
your commute, this captivating color-sorting challenge delivers a perfect blend of mental strategy and pure relaxation. Start sorting today
and see how smoothly you can solve every single puzzle!
🤝 Support & Feedback
We are always working to improve your puzzle-solving experience! Do you have questions, feedback, or need assistance with a tough level?
• Email our support team at: zephyr.support@tripledotstudios.com

Ребенок учит буквы и алфавит, цифры от 1 до 10 и начальная математика — сложение и вычитание. В приложении есть детские игры с любимыми механиками: домашние и дикие животные, учим цвета и формы. Survival is what its all about, really. You have to learn these dinosaur skills to not die, like hunting animals or finding food, and watching out for dangers all the time. Not just surviving alone, though. You can build a family of Dino and protect them, which adds this legacy thing. Its a family adventure where you grow your group and hunt together or defend your spot.

Exploring together feels real in the Dino family sim, and the animal simulator keeps it engaging.

The open world is massive, with forests and rivers, plus hidden places you stumble on. In this Jurassic setup, the forest adventure makes exploring key for staying alive, and it offers all these possibilities so each time is different.

I might be oversimplifying, but the universe is detailed enough that you don't run out of things to do quick.

Features wise, the graphics are high quality for a 3D dinosaur simulator. The environment is large and open, gameplay feels realistic for animals, and the hunting mechanics pull you in. data.name: Pixel Blast - Color Shooter
data.description_full:
Pixel Blast is a colorful, mesmerizing action-puzzle matching game where strategy meets one-tap simplicity. Match colorful marble shooters to their pixel cubes, manage a dynamic conveyor belt, and clear the board with satisfying precision. Quick to play, hard to put down—it's a short-break relaxer for killing free time and a fun way to train your mind, delivering challenging, colorful, flowing happy moments.

How to play: Conveyor loaded, shooters locked in. Tap to launch a shooter onto the belt—it’ll rain balls onto pixel cubes of the same color. The number above its head is its ammo count: that’s how many strikes it can land. Empty the ammo and the shooter exits; otherwise, it slides into 1 of 5 standby slots, ready to hop back on the conveyor with another tap for a fresh round.

Highlights

One‑tap gameplay: Quick rounds, easy one‑handed play.

Auto‑color match: Shooters only strike their own color—no aiming needed.

Conveyor limits: Timing and queue control add a snack‑sized strategy bite.

Ammo‑based shooter system: 5 conveyor capacity limits.

Quick‑session design: No manual targeting, light strategy layer.

Perfect cleanup system: Satisfying pixel clean‑up and a captivating loop flow.

“Just one more run” vibe: Ideal for micro‑breaks.

Remember that the conveyor has limited space—exceed the limit and you’ll have to wait. Deploy shooters in the right sequence, manage their flow, and blast cubes to clear the board step by step. Clean mechanics, a captivating loop: tap → stream → repeat.

For fans of fast action‑puzzles, timing, and flow‑management games.

data.name: Mesozoic Dawn
data.description_full:
The Miracle of Life Begins Here

In MESOZOIC DAWN, you don't just play a multiplayer dinosaur survival game—離ou live an evolutionary journey spanning hundreds of millions of years. Start as a vulnerable juvenile, then forage, stalk, and grow in a perilous prehistoric wild. Breakthrough your genetic limits via the core "Egg Evolution" system to claim your place at the top of the food chain!

---

✨ Core Features

🦖 A Massive Ecosystem
A unique Low Poly style brings over 70+ prehistoric species to life across sea, land, and air. Every creature possesses its own distinct survival instincts.

🧬 Unique Evolution System
Forget tedious XP bars. Progress through "Growth + Nesting = Evolution." Consume nutrient-rich food and breed to unlock more powerful prehistoric apex predators.

🫀 Hardcore Survival Mechanics
Stomach, lungs, and heart are interconnected. Hunger, stress, or injury directly damage organs and lower efficiency. Temperature, humidity, oxygen, and energy create a strict survival web where every choice matters.

⚔️ Strategic Combat
Featuring skill buffs, penetration, resilience, and a Locational Damage System. Striking different body parts yields unique damage multipliers and defensive returns. True Damage bypasses armor to deplete health and inflict trauma—high trauma will leave even fully armored players in despair by blocking heart health recovery.

🐣 Nesting and Breeding
• Diverse Paths: Choose parthenogenesis or find a mate. Temperature determines the offspring's gender; males naturally possess size and combat advantages.
• Build Your Nest: Gather stone and wood to build a nest that serves as your safe haven and respawn point. Defend it, as hostile players can destroy it.
• 🆕 Enhanced Brooding: Manually brooding eggs doubles hatching speed and stacks across generations to secure the strongest bloodline.

🧬 Genetic Inheritance
Offspring inherit traits from parents, with stats randomly breaking through limits. Shape a unique, peak bloodline through generations and selective brooding bonuses.

🤖 🆕 AI Companion & Offspring System
• Tame Wild Mates: Interact with opposite-sex wild dinosaurs of your species to build favorability and tame them as your exclusive AI mate.
• AI Offspring Management: Hatch eggs into AI offspring that follow your commands as loyal combat followers and territory guardians.
• Combat Commands: Issue orders like Follow, Attack Target, Standby, Defend, Protect, and Evade. AI companions assess threats and execute tactics independently.

🤖 Dynamic AI Herds
Encounter neutral and hostile AI herds with distinct behaviors. During special seasons, witness epic, massive migrations—a thrilling spectacle that brings both extreme danger and unmatched opportunity.

🌡️ Dynamic Climate Zones
The world is divided into distinct climate zones. Different species require specific temperature and humidity levels. Finding your ideal zone ensures survival and accelerates growth.

🌐 Online Multiplayer
Hunt with allies or clash with rival player clans over territory, water, and food. Full community server support lets you forge your own prehistoric world.

---

Are you ready for the Mesozoic Dawn?

data.name: Muse Gallery
data.description_full:
Muse Gallery
A casual puzzle game that combines stacked match-3 gameplay with a progressive story video unlock mechanism. By clearing levels, you can gradually unlock exclusive story content for multiple muses with different styles. While enjoying a relaxed puzzle-solving experience, you will gain a clear sense of in-game progression and long-term motivation to play.
Classic Stacked Match-3 Gameplay
The game centers on the popular stacked tile match-3 mechanism. In each level, tiles are stacked in multiple layers on the screen, and you need to carefully select and collect three identical tiles to clear them. As you progress through the levels, the tile layouts become more complex, requiring sharper observation, more thorough planning, and more prudent decision-making.
Each level is designed to be both easy to pick up and progressively challenging. The key to clearing levels lies not only in speed but also in understanding the tile structure and planning each move in advance.
Practical Boosters for Strategic Level-Clearing
To help you overcome difficult levels, Muse Gallery offers three practical boosters:
Undo: Undo your last move and correct critical mistakes
Remove: Directly eliminate selected tiles to open up new matching paths
Shuffle: Rearrange the remaining tiles to discover new matching solutions
Using boosters at the right time can greatly increase your chances of clearing levels, allowing you to successfully overcome difficulties without feeling frustrated.
Muse Characters and Story Unlock Mechanism
The game features dozens of unique muses, each with a series of story videos that can be unlocked in sequence. The progression system is designed to be both rewarding and well-paced:
Reach specified level milestones to unlock early story videos for free.
Watch a short video ad to unlock the final exclusive reward story videos.
New muses can only be unlocked after reaching a certain level of progress.
This layered unlock mechanism ensures that every level you complete brings you closer to new content and valuable rewards.
Progressive Level Difficulty
The difficulty of the levels increases steadily, making it suitable for both casual players and those who are keen on strategic puzzle challenges. Even if you fail a level, you can retry with adjusted strategies or optimize the use of boosters, maintaining the fun of the game throughout without severe penalties.
Special Mechanisms for Long-Term Gameplay
In addition to the core gameplay, Muse Gallery also includes a variety of mechanisms to support long-term gameplay:
Daily Check-In Rewards: Encourage players to log in daily with stable benefits.
Achievement Goals: Record every step of your growth and milestone moments.
These mechanisms provide continuous reward feedback and maintain your motivation to play in the long run.
Who Is This Game For?
Muse Gallery is especially suitable for players who:
Love match-3, tile-matching, and various puzzle games
Enjoy games with clear progression and unlockable reward mechanisms
Prefer casual games with a free rhythm that can be played on demand
By combining relaxed puzzle-solving gameplay with structured story unlock content, Muse Gallery creates a balanced gaming experience—easy to pick up, yet worth investing in for the long term. Clear levels, unlock new muse stories, and embark on a pleasant exploration journey through progressively challenging puzzles.

Start with multiple tiles already flipped open

Collect a complete picture when you've gathered its matching tiles

Continue until all pictures are collected

data.name: 青丘世界：緣起
data.description_full:
下一次遇見，在青丘世界。
2026 年旗艦級 3D 仙俠大作《青丘世界：緣起》，以超高精度建模與動態光影系統，重構東方仙俠的浪漫與壯闊。
你將化身守令一脈的末代弟子，執掌殘缺的御妖令。朱雀精魄蠢動，上古封印將破——斬妖除魔之外，更要揭開塗山氏一族世代守護的禁忌真相。諸神不臨，仙妖對峙，你的每一次選擇，都將改寫這場劫數的終局。
踏入青丘，一草一木皆靈韻，一顰一笑盡風華，在仙霧縈繞的山海間，展開屬於你的緣起之旅。

【四大職業・各具其風采】
靈狐、劍仙、逐月、龍槍——四大職業各擁獨特的戰鬥美學。
每個宗門皆配備專屬技能與覺醒造型，並可自由搭配祕法絕技，讓你創造屬於自己的仙俠風骨。

【遇見青丘・尋覓大世界】
這是一個兼具絕美風景與溫暖人情的開放仙界。你將與好友一同御劍乘風、踏雲尋蹤，一步一景，處處驚鴻，在湖邊共許願，在秘境中探險。
告別單機式修仙，讓每一次相遇，都成為牽絆的開端。

【靈韻天成 · 一顏一世界】
高自由度捏臉系統，從眉眼輪廓、衣飾妝容皆由你親手定製。從清冷仙君到嬌萌靈狐，你所思念的模樣，從此躍然於指尖。
一顏一鏡，照見獨一無二的你。

【百妖通靈・掌馭由汝心】
遊戲內藏匿著形形色色的妖靈——或憨態可掬，或威風凜凜，各具性情。你將邂逅、馴化並與牠們共生，結下獨一無二的羈絆。
每一隻妖靈皆擁有獨立的養成與進化路線，你將攜同心愛的妖靈並肩作戰，縱橫仙魔戰場。

【霓裳玉羽・纖毫畢現之美】
極致畫質，為每一件時裝賦予靈魂。綢緞的流動、輕紗的透光、金屬的冷冽、羽翼的豐盈——材質細膩到每一縷絲線。
數千款時裝配件自由搭配，更支援百萬種自由染色，隨心搭配，告別撞衫。在青丘世界，你可以比世界更多彩。

【繁花為禮・情深到家】
遊戲內外，好禮相連。在預約活動頁參與「繁花大賽」活動，或與心上人在遊戲中結成情緣，即可額外獲得真實鮮花豪禮——百萬鮮花宅配到家，讓浪漫從虛實之間綻放於眼前。

※ 本遊戲為免費使用，遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務。
※ 長時間進行遊戲，請注意使用時間，避免沉迷於遊戲。

data.name: Sky Build
data.description_full:
Feel the thrill with Sky Build and test your reaction speed! 🏗️⚡ Your task is to fill all three slots with the same symbol before time runs out.

The slots with three symbols quickly and cyclically change icons 🔄 Tap on a slot to lock the current symbol and tapping again will unlock it, but it will cost you 2 seconds ⏳ Plan your actions carefully, because every second counts.

Once all three slots are locked, the result is checked 🎯 If the symbols match, you win! If not, the slots will automatically unlock, giving you a chance to try again. For the daring, there is a “build” button 🚀 that locks all slots at once — a risky but sometimes very profitable move.

When the time runs out, the symbols are fixed where they stopped ⏱️ If they are the same, you win; if they are different, the game is over. Each level has a different time limit and the first stages are a little easier to start with. Sky Build is all about speed, strategy and excitement in every round!
